    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:

    50→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    51→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    52→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    53→    weight_by_confidence = {
    54→        "high": 1.0,
    55→        "medium": 0.7,
    56→        "low": 0.3,
    57→    }
    58→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    59→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    60→        weight *= 10.0
    61→    return float(weight)

    64→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    65→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    66→    if not scope:
    67→        return True
    68→
    69→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    70→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    71→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    72→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    73→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    74→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    75→
    76→    if "*" in scope:
    77→        return any(
    78→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    79→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    80→        )
    81→
    82→    if "::" in scope:
    83→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    84→
    85→    lowered = scope.lower()
    86→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    87→        return (
    88→            lowered in item_id.lower()
    89→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
    90→            or lowered in summary.lower()
    91→        )
    92→
    93→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
    94→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
    95→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
    96→
    97→    return (
    98→        detector == scope
    99→        or filepath == scope
   100→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   101→    )

   103→
   104→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   105→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")
   106→
   107→
   108→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   109→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   110→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   111→    target = cleaned.lower()
   112→
   113→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   114→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   115→            return str(dim_key)
   116→    return slugify(cleaned)
   117→
   118→
   119→def _subjective_dimension_aliases(display_name: str) -> set[str]:
   120→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   121→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   122→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   123→    return {
   124→        cleaned.lower(),
   125→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   126→        slugify(cleaned),
   127→        canonical.lower(),
   128→        slugify(canonical),
   129→    }
   130→

   132→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   133→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   134→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   135→    if not lang:
   136→        return None
   137→
   138→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   139→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   140→        return None
   141→
   142→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   143→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   144→        return None
   145→
   146→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   147→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   148→        return None
   149→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
   150→

   152→def primary_command_for_finding(
   153→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   154→) -> str:
   155→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   156→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   157→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   158→        available_fixers = [
   159→            fixer
   160→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   161→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   162→        ]
   163→        if available_fixers:
   164→            return f"desloppify fix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   165→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   166→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   167→            return "desloppify review --prepare"
   168→        return "desloppify show subjective"
   169→    return f'desloppify plan done "{item.get("id", "")}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'

   172→def build_synthesis_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   173→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``synthesis::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   174→
   175→    Returns an empty list when no synthesis stages are pending.
   176→    """
   177→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.synthesis_playbook import (
   178→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   179→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS,
   180→    )
   181→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   182→        SYNTHESIS_IDS,
   183→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS,
   184→    )
   185→
   186→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   187→    order_set = set(order)
   188→    present = order_set & SYNTHESIS_IDS
   189→    if not present:
   190→        return []
   191→
   192→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   193→    confirmed = set(meta.get("synthesis_stages", {}).keys())
   194→
   195→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   196→    open_review_count = sum(
   197→        1 for f in findings.values()
   198→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   199→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   200→    )
   201→
   202→    label_map = dict(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_LABELS)
   203→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   204→
   205→    items: list[dict] = []
   206→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   207→        if sid not in present:
   208→            continue
   209→        if name in confirmed:
   210→            continue
   211→
   212→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   213→        deps = SYNTHESIS_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   214→        blocked_by = sorted(
   215→            f"synthesis::{dep}" for dep in deps
   216→            if f"synthesis::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   217→        )
   218→
   219→        cmd = f"desloppify plan synthesize --stage {name}"
   220→        if name == "commit":
   221→            cmd = 'desloppify plan synthesize --complete --strategy "..."'
   222→
   223→        items.append({
   224→            "id": sid,
   225→            "tier": 1,
   226→            "confidence": "high",
   227→            "detector": "synthesis",
   228→            "file": ".",
   229→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   230→            "stage_name": name,
   231→            "stage_index": idx,
   232→            "summary": f"Planning: {label_map.get(name, name)}",
   233→            "detail": {
   234→                "total_review_findings": open_review_count,
   235→                "stage": name,
   236→                "stage_label": label_map.get(name, name),
   237→            },
   238→            "primary_command": cmd,
   239→            "blocked_by": blocked_by,
   240→            "is_blocked": bool(blocked_by),
   241→        })
   242→    return items

   270→def subjective_strict_scores(state: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
   271→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   272→    if not dim_scores:
   273→        return {}
   274→
   275→    entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   276→    scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   277→    for entry in entries:
   278→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   279→        if not name:
   280→            continue
   281→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   282→        [REDACTED](name)
   283→        aliases = _subjective_dimension_aliases(name)
   284→        for cli_key in entry.get("cli_keys", []):
   285→            key = str(cli_key).strip().lower()
   286→            if not key:
   287→                continue
   288→            aliases.add(key)
   289→            aliases.add(slugify(key))
   290→        aliases.add(dim_key.lower())
   291→        aliases.add(slugify(dim_key))
   292→        for alias in aliases:
   293→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   294→    return scores
   295→
   296→
   297→def _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores: dict) -> list[dict]:
   298→    """Build scorecard-like entries for unassessed placeholder dimensions.
   299→
   300→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` goes through the scorecard pipeline which
   301→    intentionally hides placeholders from display.  This function reads
   302→    ``dimension_scores`` directly so initial-review items are never lost.
   303→    """
   304→    entries: list[dict] = []
   305→    for name, data in dim_scores.items():
   306→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   307→            continue
   308→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   309→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
   310→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
   311→            continue
   312→        if not meta.get("placeholder"):
   313→            continue
   314→        dim_key = meta.get("dimension_key", "")
   315→        entries.append(
   316→            {
   317→                "name": name,
   318→                "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
   319→                "strict": float(data.get("strict", 0.0)),
   320→                "checks": int(data.get("checks", 0) or 0),
   321→                "issues": int(data.get("issues", 0) or 0),
   322→                "tier": int(data.get("tier", 4) or 4),
   323→                "placeholder": True,
   324→                "stale": False,
   325→                "dimension_key": dim_key,
   326→                "cli_keys": [dim_key] if dim_key else [],
   327→            }
   328→        )
   329→    return entries
   330→
   331→
   332→def build_subjective_items(
   333→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   334→) -> list[dict]:
   335→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   336→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   337→    if not dim_scores:
   338→        return []
   339→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   340→
   341→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   342→
   343→    # The scorecard pipeline hides unassessed placeholders from display.
   344→    # Merge them in so initial-review items always appear in the queue.
   345→    seen_dims: set[str] = {
   346→        str(e.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   347→        for e in subjective_entries
   348→        if e.get("dimension_key")
   349→    }
   350→    for entry in _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores):
   351→        dk = str(entry.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   352→        if dk and dk not in seen_dims:
   353→            subjective_entries.append(entry)
   354→            seen_dims.add(dk)
   355→
   356→    if not subjective_entries:
   357→        return []
   358→    unassessed_dims = {
   359→        str(name).strip()
   360→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   361→            dim_scores
   362→        )
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   366→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   367→    for finding in findings.values():
   368→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   369→            continue
   370→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   371→        if not dim_key:
   372→            continue
   373→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   374→
   375→    items: list[dict] = []
   376→    def _prepare_command(
   377→        cli_keys: list[str],
   378→        *,
   379→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   380→    ) -> str:
   381→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   382→        if cli_keys:
   383→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   384→        if force_review_rerun:
   385→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   386→        return command
   387→
   388→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   389→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   390→        if not name:
   391→            continue
   392→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   393→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   394→            continue
   395→
   396→        [REDACTED](name)
   397→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   398→        cli_keys = [
   399→            str(key).strip().lower()
   400→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   401→            if str(key).strip()
   402→        ]
   403→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   404→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   405→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   406→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   407→            name in unassessed_dims
   408→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   409→        )
   410→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   411→        # Items whose only action is --force-review-rerun are gated by the
   412→        # review preflight while objective backlog exists.  Flag them so the
   413→        # queue builder can suppress them until the backlog drains.
   414→        is_backlog_gated = open_review == 0 and not is_unassessed
   415→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   416→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   417→        if open_review > 0:
   418→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   419→        elif is_unassessed:
   420→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   421→        elif is_stale:
   422→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   423→                cli_keys,
   424→                force_review_rerun=True,
   425→            )
   426→        elif cli_keys:
   427→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   428→                cli_keys,
   429→                force_review_rerun=True,
   430→            )
   431→        else:
   432→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   433→                cli_keys,
   434→                force_review_rerun=True,
   435→            )
   436→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   437→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   438→        items.append(
   439→            {
   440→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   441→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   442→                "file": ".",
   443→                "confidence": "medium",
   444→                "summary": summary,
   445→                "detail": {
   446→                    "dimension_name": name,
   447→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   448→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   449→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   450→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   451→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   452→                },
   453→                "status": "open",
   454→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   455→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   456→                "backlog_gated": is_backlog_gated,
   457→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   458→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   459→            }
   460→        )
   461→    return items

    26→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    27→class QueueBuildOptions:
    28→    """Configuration for queue construction."""
    29→
    30→    count: int | None = 1
    31→    scan_path: str | None = None
    32→    scope: str | None = None
    33→    status: str = "open"
    34→    include_subjective: bool = True
    35→    subjective_threshold: float = 100.0
    36→    chronic: bool = False
    37→    explain: bool = False
    38→    plan: dict | None = None
    39→    include_skipped: bool = False

    44→class WorkQueueResult(TypedDict):
    45→    """Typed shape of the dict returned by :func:`build_work_queue`."""
    46→
    47→    items: list[dict]
    48→    total: int
    49→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]

    52→
    53→def _is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    54→    """Return True for queue items that represent subjective work."""
    55→    return item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" or bool(item.get("is_subjective"))
    56→
    57→
    58→def _apply_subjective_interleave_guardrail(
    59→    items: list[dict],
    60→    *,
    61→    objective_burst: int = 3,
    62→    subjective_burst: int = 1,
    63→) -> list[dict]:
    64→    """Interleave subjective work with objective work to avoid starvation."""
    65→    if objective_burst < 1 or subjective_burst < 1:
    66→        return items
    67→
    68→    subjective_items = deque(
    69→        item for item in items if _is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    70→    )
    71→    objective_items = deque(
    72→        item for item in items if not _is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    73→    )
    74→    if not subjective_items or not objective_items:
    75→        return items
    76→
    77→    interleaved: list[dict] = []
    78→    while objective_items and subjective_items:
    79→        for _ in range(objective_burst):
    80→            if not objective_items:
    81→                break
    82→            interleaved.append(objective_items.popleft())
    83→        for _ in range(subjective_burst):
    84→            if not subjective_items:
    85→                break
    86→            interleaved.append(subjective_items.popleft())
    87→
    88→    interleaved.extend(objective_items)
    89→    interleaved.extend(subjective_items)
    90→    return interleaved
    91→
    92→
    93→def _new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    94→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    95→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    96→    if not scan_history:
    97→        return set()
    98→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    99→    if not threshold:
   100→        return set()
   101→    return {
   102→        fid
   103→        for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   104→        if f.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
   105→    }
   106→
   107→
   108→def _apply_plan_order(
   109→    items: list[dict],
   110→    plan: dict,
   111→    *,
   112→    include_skipped: bool = False,
   113→    cluster: str | None = None,
   114→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
   115→) -> list[dict]:
   116→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
   117→
   118→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
   119→    2. Existing remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
   120→    3. New items (from latest scan) sort after existing remaining items.
   121→    4. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
   122→    5. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
   123→    """
   124→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   125→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   126→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   127→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
   128→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   129→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
   130→
   131→    # Build lookup
   132→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
   133→    for item in items:
   134→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
   135→
   136→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
   137→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
   138→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
   139→        if override.get("description"):
   140→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
   141→        if override.get("note"):
   142→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
   143→        if override.get("cluster"):
   144→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
   145→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   146→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
   147→                "name": cluster_name,
   148→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
   149→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
   150→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
   151→            }
   152→
   153→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   154→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   155→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   156→    for fid in queue_order:
   157→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   158→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   159→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   160→
   161→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   162→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
   163→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
   164→    _new = new_ids or set()
   165→    for item in items:
   166→        item_id = item["id"]
   167→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   168→            continue
   169→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   170→            skipped_items.append(item)
   171→        elif item_id in _new:
   172→            remaining_new.append(item)
   173→        else:
   174→            remaining_existing.append(item)
   175→
   176→    # Assign queue positions — new items after existing ones
   177→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
   178→    if include_skipped:
   179→        result = result + skipped_items
   180→
   181→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   182→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   183→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   184→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   185→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   186→            if skip_entry:
   187→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   188→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   189→                if skip_reason:
   190→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   191→
   192→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   193→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   194→    if effective_cluster:
   195→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   196→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   197→        if cluster_member_ids:
   198→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   199→
   200→    return result
   201→
   202→
   203→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   204→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   205→    try:
   206→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   207→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   208→        if meta:
   209→            return meta.action_type
   210→    except ImportError as exc:
   211→        _ = exc
   212→    return "manual_fix"
   213→
   214→
   215→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   216→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items."""
   217→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   218→    if not clusters:
   219→        return items
   220→
   221→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   222→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   223→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   224→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   225→            continue
   226→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   227→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   228→
   229→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   230→        return items
   231→
   232→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   233→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   234→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   235→
   236→    for item in items:
   237→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   238→        if cname:
   239→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   240→        else:
   241→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   242→
   243→    # Build cluster meta-items
   244→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   245→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   246→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   247→        if len(members) < 2:
   248→            result.extend(members)
   249→            continue
   250→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   251→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   252→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   253→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   254→        if "desloppify fix" in action:
   255→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   256→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   257→            action_type = "reorganize"
   258→        else:
   259→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   260→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   261→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   262→                action_type = "refactor"
   263→
   264→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   265→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   266→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   267→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   268→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   269→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   270→        else:
   271→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   272→
   273→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   274→        if not primary_command:
   275→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   276→
   277→        meta_item: dict = {
   278→            "id": cname,
   279→            "kind": "cluster",
   280→            "action_type": action_type,
   281→            "summary": summary,
   282→            "members": members,
   283→            "member_count": len(members),
   284→            "primary_command": primary_command,
   285→            "cluster_name": cname,
   286→            "cluster_auto": True,
   287→            "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   288→            "confidence": "high",
   289→            "detector": detector,
   290→            "file": "",
   291→        }
   292→        result.append(meta_item)
   293→
   294→    result.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   295→    return result
   296→
   297→
   298→def build_work_queue(
   299→    state: StateModel,
   300→    *,
   301→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   302→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   303→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   304→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   305→
   306→    status = resolved_options.status
   307→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   308→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   309→    try:
   310→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   311→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   312→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   313→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   314→
   315→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   316→        state,
   317→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   318→        status_filter=status,
   319→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   320→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   321→    )
   322→
   323→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   324→    has_objective_backlog = bool(finding_items)
   325→    suppressed_count = 0
   326→    if (
   327→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   328→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   329→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   330→    ):
   331→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   332→            state,
   333→            state.get("findings", {}),
   334→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   335→        )
   336→        for item in subjective_items:
   337→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   338→                continue
   339→            # Suppress subjective items whose only action is a review rerun
   340→            # (--force-review-rerun) while objective backlog exists — the
   341→            # review preflight blocks reruns until the backlog drains.
   342→            if has_objective_backlog and item.get("backlog_gated"):
   343→                suppressed_count += 1
   344→                continue
   345→            all_items.append(item)
   346→
   347→    # Inject synthesis stage items and workflow items when plan requires it
   348→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   349→        synth_items = build_synthesis_stage_items(resolved_options.plan, state)
   350→        all_items.extend(synth_items)
   351→        plan_item = build_create_plan_item(resolved_options.plan)
   352→        if plan_item is not None:
   353→            all_items.append(plan_item)
   354→
   355→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   356→
   357→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   358→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
   359→    if resolved_options.plan:
   360→        new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   361→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   362→            all_items,
   363→            resolved_options.plan,
   364→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   365→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   366→            new_ids=new_ids,
   367→        )
   368→
   369→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   370→    should_collapse = (
   371→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   372→        and resolved_options.plan
   373→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   374→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   375→    )
   376→    if should_collapse:
   377→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   378→
   379→    should_interleave = (
   380→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   381→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   382→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   383→        and not resolved_options.scope
   384→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   385→    )
   386→    if should_interleave:
   387→        all_items = _apply_subjective_interleave_guardrail(all_items)
   388→
   389→    total = len(all_items)
   390→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   391→        all_items = all_items[: resolved_options.count]
   392→
   393→    if resolved_options.explain:
   394→        for item in all_items:
   395→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   396→
   397→    return {
   398→        "items": all_items,
   399→        "total": total,
   400→        "grouped": group_queue_items(all_items, "item"),
   401→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   402→        "suppressed_count": suppressed_count,
   403→    }
   404→
   405→
   406→__all__ = [
   407→    "ATTEST_EXAMPLE",
   408→    "QueueBuildOptions",
   409→    "WorkQueueResult",
   410→    "build_work_queue",
   411→    "group_queue_items",
   412→]
   413→

   380→def show_empty_queue(
   381→    queue: dict,
   382→    strict: float | None,
   383→    *,
   384→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   385→    target_strict: float | None = None,
   386→) -> bool:
   387→    if queue.get("items"):
   388→        return False
   389→    # Show before/after comparison when plan_start_strict is available
   390→    if plan_start_strict is not None and strict is not None:
   391→        delta = round(strict - plan_start_strict, 1)
   392→        delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
   393→        print(colorize("\n  Queue cleared!", "green"))
   394→        print(colorize(
   395→            f"  Frozen plan-start: strict {plan_start_strict:.1f} → Live estimate: strict {strict:.1f}{delta_str}",
   396→            "cyan",

   400→            "dim",

   403→        suffix = f" Strict score: {strict:.1f}/100" if strict is not None else ""
   404→        print(colorize(f"\n  Nothing to do!{suffix}", "green"))
   405→    return True

   408→def _render_compact_item(item: dict, idx: int, total: int) -> None:
   409→    """One-line summary for cluster drill-in items after the first."""
   410→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   411→    tag = _effort_tag(item)
   412→    tag_str = f" {tag}" if tag else ""
   413→    fid = item.get("id", "")
   414→    short = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1][:8] if "::" in fid else fid
   415→    print(f"  [{idx + 1}/{total}] [{confidence}]{tag_str} {item.get('summary', '')}")
   416→    print(colorize(f"         {item.get('file', '')}  [{short}]", "dim"))

   419→def render_terminal_items(
   420→    items: list[dict],
   421→    dim_scores: dict,
   422→    findings_scoped: dict,
   423→    *,
   424→    group: str,
   425→    explain: bool,
   426→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   427→    plan: dict | None = None,
   428→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   429→) -> None:
   430→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   431→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   432→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   433→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   434→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   435→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   436→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   437→
   438→    if group != "item":
   439→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   440→        return
   441→
   442→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   443→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   444→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   445→    )
   446→
   447→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   448→        if idx > 0:
   449→            print()
   450→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   451→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   452→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   453→            continue
   454→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   455→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   456→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   457→        elif len(items) > 1:
   458→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   459→        else:
   460→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   461→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   462→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   463→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   464→

   466→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   467→    if len(items) != 1:
   468→        return
   469→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   470→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   471→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   472→    if kind != "finding":
   473→        return
   474→    item = items[0]
   475→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   476→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   477→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   478→        primary = item.get(
   479→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   480→        )
   481→        print(f"    {primary}")
   482→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   483→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   484→        return
   485→
   486→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   487→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   488→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   489→        print(f"    {primary}")
   490→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   491→    else:
   492→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))
   493→
   494→    print(
   495→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'
   496→    )
   497→    print(
   498→        f'    desloppify plan skip --permanent "{item["id"]}" --note "<why>" '
   499→        f'--attest "{ATTEST_EXAMPLE}"'

   503→def render_followup_nudges(
   504→    state: dict,
   505→    dim_scores: dict,
   506→    findings_scoped: dict,
   507→    *,
   508→    strict_score: float | None,
   509→    target_strict_score: float,
   510→    queue_total: int = 0,
   511→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   512→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   513→) -> None:
   514→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   515→        format_queue_block,
   516→    )
   517→
   518→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   519→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   520→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   521→        state,
   522→        subjective_entries,
   523→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   524→        max_quality_items=3,
   525→        max_integrity_items=5,
   526→    )
   527→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   528→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   529→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   530→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   531→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   532→        print()
   533→        for text, style in block:
   534→            print(colorize(text, style))
   535→        print(colorize(
   536→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   537→            "dim",
   538→        ))
   539→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   540→        print(
   541→            colorize(
   542→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   543→                "cyan",
   544→            )
   545→        )
   546→        print(
   547→            colorize(
   548→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   549→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   550→                "dim",
   551→            )
   552→        )
   553→    elif strict_score is not None:
   554→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   555→        if gap > 0:
   556→            print(
   557→                colorize(
   558→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   559→                    "cyan",
   560→                )
   561→            )
   562→        else:
   563→            print(
   564→                colorize(
   565→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   566→                    "green",
   567→                )
   568→            )
   569→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   570→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   571→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   572→        for text, style in block:
   573→            print(colorize(text, style))
   574→
   575→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   576→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   577→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   578→    _objective_remaining = max(
   579→        0,
   580→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   581→    )
   582→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   583→        try:
   584→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   585→            subjective_drag = sum(
   586→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   587→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   588→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   589→            )
   590→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   591→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   592→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   593→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   594→            )
   595→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   596→                print(colorize(
   597→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   598→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   599→                    "yellow",
   600→                ))
   601→                print(colorize(
   602→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   603→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   604→                    "to re-score.",
   605→                    "yellow",
   606→                ))
   607→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   608→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   609→
   610→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   611→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   612→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   613→
   614→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   615→    if queue_total > 10:
   616→        print(colorize(
   617→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   618→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   619→            "dim",
   620→        ))
   621→
   622→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   623→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   624→        findings_scoped
   625→    )
   626→    parts: list[str] = []
   627→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   628→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   629→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   630→    open_review = [
   631→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   632→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   633→    ]
   634→    if low_dims:
   635→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   636→    if stale_count:
   637→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   638→    if unassessed_count:
   639→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   640→    if len(open_review):
   641→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   642→    if coverage_open > 0:
   643→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   644→
   645→    if parts:
   646→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   647→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   648→

     6→
     7→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.guardrails import print_synthesis_guardrail_info
     8→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.runtime import command_runtime
     9→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.state import require_completed_scan
    10→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize, print_table
    11→from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_new_finding_ids, load_plan
    12→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    13→
    14→
    15→def _truncate(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    16→    if len(text) <= width:
    17→        return text
    18→    return text[: width - 1] + "\u2026"
    19→
    20→
    21→def _resolve_plan_context(plan: dict, cluster_filter: str | None) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    22→    plan_data: dict | None = None
    23→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
    24→        plan_data = plan
    25→
    26→    effective_cluster = cluster_filter
    27→    if plan_data and not cluster_filter:
    28→        active_cluster = plan_data.get("active_cluster")
    29→        if active_cluster:
    30→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
    31→    return plan_data, effective_cluster
    32→
    33→
    34→def _print_queue_header(
    35→    *,
    36→    items: list[dict],
    37→    include_skipped: bool,
    38→    plan: dict,
    39→    plan_data: dict | None,
    40→    new_count: int = 0,
    41→) -> None:
    42→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
    43→        QueueBreakdown,
    44→        format_queue_headline,
    45→    )
    46→
    47→    total = len(items)
    48→    skipped_count = sum(1 for it in items if it.get("plan_skipped"))
    49→    non_skipped = total - skipped_count
    50→    plan_skipped_total = len(plan.get("skipped", {})) if plan_data else 0
    51→
    52→    # Count subjective items in the visible list
    53→    subjective = sum(
    54→        1 for it in items if it.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension"
    55→    )
    56→
    57→    # Count plan-ordered items (minus skipped)
    58→    plan_ordered = 0
    59→    if plan_data:
    60→        queue_order = plan_data.get("queue_order", [])
    61→        skipped_ids = set(plan_data.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    62→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
    63→
    64→    breakdown = QueueBreakdown(
    65→        queue_total=non_skipped,
    66→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
    67→        skipped=plan_skipped_total,
    68→        subjective=subjective,
    69→    )
    70→    headline = format_queue_headline(breakdown)
    71→    new_suffix = f"  ({new_count} new this scan)" if new_count > 0 else ""
    72→    print(colorize(f"\n  {headline}{new_suffix}", "bold"))
    73→
    74→    focus = plan.get("active_cluster") if plan_data else None
    75→    if focus:
    76→        print(colorize(f"  Focus: {focus}", "cyan"))
    77→
    78→    if include_skipped or skipped_count != 0:
    79→        return
    80→    if not plan_skipped_total:
    81→        return
    82→    print(
    83→        colorize(
    84→            f"  ({plan_skipped_total} skipped item{'s' if plan_skipped_total != 1 else ''}"
    85→            " hidden — use --include-skipped)",
    86→            "dim",
    87→        )
    88→    )
    89→
    90→
    91→def _queue_display_items(items: list[dict], *, top: int) -> list[dict]:
    92→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
    93→        return items[:top]
    94→    return items
    95→
    96→
    97→def _build_rows(display_items: list[dict], new_ids: set[str] | None = None) -> list[list[str]]:
    98→    rows: list[list[str]] = []
    99→    _new = new_ids or set()
   100→    for idx, item in enumerate(display_items, 1):
   101→        pos = str(idx)
   102→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   103→
   104→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   105→            blocked = item.get("is_blocked", False)
   106→            blocked_tag = " [blocked]" if blocked else ""
   107→            conf_str = "—"
   108→            detector = "planning"
   109→            summary = f"{item.get('summary', '')}{blocked_tag}"
   110→            cluster_name = ""
   111→        elif kind == "workflow_action":
   112→            conf_str = "—"
   113→            detector = "workflow"
   114→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   115→            cluster_name = ""
   116→        elif kind == "cluster":
   117→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "high")
   118→            member_count = item.get("member_count", 0)
   119→            detector = item.get("detector", "cluster")
   120→            new_in_cluster = sum(
   121→                1 for m in item.get("members", [])
   122→                if m.get("id") in _new
   123→            )
   124→            new_tag = f" (+{new_in_cluster} new)" if new_in_cluster else ""
   125→            summary = f"[{member_count} items{new_tag}] {item.get('summary', '')}"
   126→            cluster_name = item.get("cluster_name", item.get("id", ""))
   127→        else:
   128→            conf_str = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   129→            detector = item.get("detector", "")
   130→            summary = item.get("summary", "")
   131→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   132→            cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "") if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else ""
   133→
   134→        prefix = "* " if item.get("id") in _new else ""
   135→        suffix = " [skip]" if item.get("plan_skipped") else ""
   136→        summary_display = _truncate(prefix + summary, 48) + suffix
   137→        rows.append([pos, conf_str, detector, summary_display, cluster_name])
   138→    return rows
   139→
   140→
   141→def cmd_plan_queue(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   142→    """Render a compact table of all upcoming queue items."""
   143→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   144→    state = runtime.state
   145→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   146→        return
   147→
   148→    top = getattr(args, "top", 30)
   149→    cluster_filter = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   150→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   151→
   152→    plan = load_plan()
   153→    print_synthesis_guardrail_info(plan=plan, state=state)
   154→    plan_data, effective_cluster = _resolve_plan_context(plan, cluster_filter)
   155→
   156→    queue = build_work_queue(
   157→        state,
   158→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   159→            count=None,
   160→            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),
   161→            status="open",
   162→            include_subjective=True,
   163→            plan=plan_data,
   164→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   165→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   166→            collapse_clusters=True,
   167→        ),
   168→    )
   169→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   170→
   171→    sort_by = getattr(args, "sort", "priority")
   172→    all_new_ids: set[str] = queue.get("new_ids", set())
   173→    # Merge review-based new finding IDs (since last synthesis)
   174→    review_new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(plan, state)
   175→    all_new_ids = all_new_ids | review_new_ids
   176→    item_ids = {it.get("id") for it in items}
   177→    new_ids = all_new_ids & item_ids
   178→
   179→    if sort_by == "recent":
   180→        items = sorted(items, key=lambda it: it.get("first_seen", ""), reverse=True)
   181→
   182→    _print_queue_header(
   183→        items=items,
   184→        include_skipped=include_skipped,
   185→        plan=plan,
   186→        plan_data=plan_data,
   187→        new_count=len(new_ids),
   188→    )
   189→
   190→    if not items:
   191→        print(colorize("\n  Queue is empty.", "green"))
   192→        return
   193→
   194→    # Determine which items to show
   195→    display_items = _queue_display_items(items, top=top)
   196→    headers = ["#", "Confidence", "Detector", "Summary", "Cluster"]
   197→    rows = _build_rows(display_items, new_ids=new_ids)
   198→
   199→    print()
   200→    widths = [4, 4, 12, 50, 16]
   201→    print_table(headers, rows, widths=widths)
   202→
   203→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
   204→        remaining = len(items) - top
   205→        print(colorize(
   206→            f"\n  ... and {remaining} more (use --top 0 to show all)", "dim"
   207→        ))
   208→    print()
   209→
   210→
   211→__all__ = ["cmd_plan_queue"]
   212→

    58→def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:

    68→def _save_plan_state_transactional(

    73→    state_path_value: Path | None,

    76→    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)

    78→    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)

   144→def cmd_plan_skip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   145→    """Skip findings — unified command for temporary/permanent/false-positive."""
   146→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   147→    state = runtime.state
   148→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   149→        return
   150→
   151→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   152→    reason: str | None = getattr(args, "reason", None)
   153→    review_after: int | None = getattr(args, "review_after", None)
   154→    permanent: bool = getattr(args, "permanent", False)
   155→    false_positive: bool = getattr(args, "false_positive", False)
   156→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   157→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   158→
   159→    # Determine skip kind
   160→    if false_positive:
   161→        kind = "false_positive"
   162→    elif permanent:
   163→        kind = "permanent"
   164→    else:
   165→        kind = "temporary"
   166→
   167→    # Validate requirements for permanent/false_positive
   168→    if kind in ("permanent", "false_positive"):
   169→        if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   170→            show_attestation_requirement(
   171→                "Permanent skip" if kind == "permanent" else "False positive",
   172→                attestation,
   173→                ATTEST_EXAMPLE,
   174→            )
   175→            return
   176→        if kind == "permanent" and not note:
   177→            print(
   178→                colorize("  --permanent requires --note to explain the decision.", "yellow"),
   179→                file=sys.stderr,
   180→            )
   181→            return
   182→
   183→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   184→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   185→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   186→    finding_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
   187→    if not finding_ids:
   188→        print(colorize("  No matching findings found.", "yellow"))
   189→        return

   191→    # For permanent/false_positive: delegate to state layer for score impact
   192→    state_data: dict | None = None
   193→    if kind in ("permanent", "false_positive"):
   194→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   195→        status = "wontfix" if kind == "permanent" else "false_positive"
   196→        for fid in finding_ids:
   197→            state_mod.resolve_findings(
   198→                state_data, fid, status, note or "", attestation=attestation
   199→            )
   200→
   201→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   202→    count = skip_items(
   203→        plan,
   204→        finding_ids,
   205→        kind=kind,
   206→        reason=reason,
   207→        note=note,
   208→        attestation=attestation,
   209→        review_after=review_after,
   210→        scan_count=scan_count,
   211→    )
   212→
   213→    # Log the skip action
   214→    append_log_entry(
   215→        plan,
   216→        "skip",
   217→        finding_ids=finding_ids,
   218→        actor="user",
   219→        note=note,
   220→        detail={"kind": kind, "reason": reason},
   221→    )
   222→    if state_data is not None:
   223→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   224→            plan=plan,
   225→            plan_path=plan_file,
   226→            state_data=state_data,
   227→            state_path_value=state_file,
   228→        )
   229→    else:
   230→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   231→
   232→    label = {"temporary": "Skipped", "permanent": "Wontfixed", "false_positive": "Marked false positive"}
   233→    print(colorize(f"  {label[kind]} {count} item(s).", "green"))
   234→    if review_after:
   235→        print(colorize(f"  Will re-surface after {review_after} scan(s).", "dim"))
   236→
   237→
   238→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   239→    """Unskip findings — bring back to queue."""
   240→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   241→    state = runtime.state
   242→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   243→        return
   244→
   245→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   246→
   247→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   248→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   249→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   250→    # For unskip we need to match against all statuses (skipped items may be wontfix/fp)
   251→    finding_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   252→    if not finding_ids:
   253→        print(colorize("  No matching findings found.", "yellow"))
   254→        return
   255→
   256→    count, need_reopen = unskip_items(plan, finding_ids)
   257→    append_log_entry(
   258→        plan, "unskip", finding_ids=finding_ids, actor="user",
   259→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   260→    )
   261→
   262→    # Reopen permanent/false_positive items in state
   263→    reopened: list[str] = []
   264→    if need_reopen:
   265→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   266→        for fid in need_reopen:
   267→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_findings(state_data, fid, "open"))
   268→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   269→            plan=plan,
   270→            plan_path=plan_file,
   271→            state_data=state_data,
   272→            state_path_value=state_file,
   273→        )
   274→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} finding(s) in state.", "dim"))
   275→    else:
   276→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   277→
   278→    print(colorize(f"  Unskipped {count} item(s) — back in queue.", "green"))
   279→
   280→
   281→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   282→# Reopen
   283→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   284→
   285→def cmd_plan_reopen(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   286→    """Reopen resolved findings from plan context."""
   287→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   288→
   289→    raw_state_path = state_path(args)
   290→    state_file = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, Path) else Path(raw_state_path) if raw_state_path else None
   291→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   292→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   293→
   294→    reopened: list[str] = []
   295→    for pattern in patterns:
   296→        reopened.extend(
   297→            state_mod.resolve_findings(state_data, pattern, "open")
   298→        )
   299→
   300→    if not reopened:
   301→        print(colorize("  No resolved findings matching: " + " ".join(patterns), "yellow"))
   302→        return
   303→
   304→    # Remove from skipped if present, and ensure all reopened IDs are in queue
   305→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   306→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   307→    count = 0
   308→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   309→    for fid in reopened:
   310→        if fid in skipped:
   311→            skipped.pop(fid)
   312→            count += 1
   313→        if fid not in order:
   314→            plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   315→            order.add(fid)
   316→            count += 1
   317→    append_log_entry(
   318→        plan, "reopen", finding_ids=reopened, actor="user",
   319→    )
   320→    _save_plan_state_transactional(
   321→        plan=plan,
   322→        plan_path=plan_file,
   323→        state_data=state_data,
   324→        state_path_value=state_file,
   325→    )
   326→
   327→    print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} finding(s).", "green"))
   328→    if count:
   329→        print(colorize(f"  Plan updated: items moved back to queue.", "dim"))
   330→
   331→
   332→_CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD = 10
   333→
   334→
   335→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   336→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   337→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   338→    for pattern in patterns:
   339→        if pattern in clusters:
   340→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   341→            ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   342→            if len(ids) == 0:
   343→                print(colorize(
   344→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   345→                    "yellow",
   346→                ))
   347→                print(colorize(
   348→                    f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <finding-id>",
   349→                    "dim",
   350→                ))
   351→                return True  # blocked
   352→            if len(ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
   353→                _print_cluster_guard(pattern, ids, state)
   354→                return True  # blocked
   355→    return False  # OK
   356→
   357→
   358→def _print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
   359→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   360→    print(colorize(
   361→        f"\n  Cluster '{cluster_name}' has {len(finding_ids)} item(s) — mark them done individually first:\n",
   362→        "yellow",
   363→    ))
   364→    for fid in finding_ids:
   365→        f = findings.get(fid, {})
   366→        summary = f.get("summary", "(no summary)")[:80]
   367→        detector = f.get("detector", "?")
   368→        print(f"    {fid}  [{detector}]  {summary}")
   369→    print(colorize(
   370→        f"\n  Use: desloppify resolve <id> --status fixed --note '...' --attest '...'",
   371→        "dim",
   372→    ))
   373→    print(colorize(
   374→        f"  Or mark each done: desloppify plan done <id> --note '...' --confirm\n",
   375→        "dim",
   376→    ))
   377→
   378→
   379→def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
   380→    """Return True if the ID is a synthetic workflow/synthesis item, not a real finding."""
   381→    return fid.startswith("synthesis::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")
   382→
   383→
   384→def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str], plan: dict) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   385→    """Separate synthetic IDs from real finding patterns.
   386→
   387→    Returns (synthetic_ids, remaining_patterns).
   388→    """
   389→    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   390→    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   391→    return synthetic, remaining
   392→
   393→
   394→def cmd_plan_done(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   395→    """Mark findings as fixed — delegates to cmd_resolve for rich UX."""
   396→    from desloppify.app.commands.resolve.cmd import cmd_resolve
   397→
   398→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   399→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   400→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   401→
   402→    # --confirm: auto-generate attestation from --note
   403→    if getattr(args, "confirm", False):
   404→        if not note:
   405→            print(colorize("  --confirm requires --note to describe what you did.", "red"))
   406→            return
   407→        attestation = f"I have actually {note} and I am not gaming the score."
   408→        args.attest = attestation
   409→
   410→    # Handle synthetic IDs (synthesis::*, workflow::*, subjective::*) directly
   411→    synthetic_ids, real_patterns = _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns, load_plan())
   412→    if synthetic_ids:
   413→        plan = load_plan()
   414→        purge_ids(plan, synthetic_ids)
   415→        append_log_entry(
   416→            plan, "done", finding_ids=synthetic_ids, actor="user", note=note,
   417→        )
   418→        save_plan(plan)
   419→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   420→            print(colorize(f"  Resolved: {sid}", "green"))
   421→        if not real_patterns:
   422→            return
   423→        # Continue with remaining real patterns
   424→        patterns = real_patterns
   425→        args.patterns = patterns
   426→
   427→    # Validate note length
   428→    if not validate_note_length(note):
   429→        show_note_length_requirement(note)
   430→        return
   431→
   432→    # Pre-validate attestation before delegating (avoids stale hint in resolve)
   433→    if not validate_attestation(attestation):
   434→        show_attestation_requirement("Plan done", attestation, ATTEST_EXAMPLE)
   435→        return
   436→
   437→    # Cluster completion guard: block bulk-completing small clusters
   438→    try:
   439→        runtime = command_runtime(args)
   440→        state = runtime.state
   441→        plan = load_plan()
   442→        if _check_cluster_guard(patterns, plan, state):
   443→            return
   444→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   445→        plan = None
   446→
   447→    # Log the done action (best-effort)
   448→    try:
   449→        if plan is None:
   450→            plan = load_plan()
   451→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   452→        cluster_name = None
   453→        for p in patterns:
   454→            if p in clusters:
   455→                cluster_name = p
   456→                break
   457→        append_log_entry(
   458→            plan,
   459→            "done",
   460→            finding_ids=patterns,
   461→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   462→            actor="user",
   463→            note=note,
   464→        )
   465→        save_plan(plan)
   466→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
   467→        pass  # best-effort logging
   468→
   469→    # Build a Namespace that cmd_resolve expects
   470→    resolve_args = argparse.Namespace(
   471→        status="fixed",
   472→        patterns=patterns,
   473→        note=note,
   474→        attest=attestation,
   475→        confirm_batch_wontfix=False,
   476→        force_resolve=bool(getattr(args, "force_resolve", False)),
   477→        state=getattr(args, "state", None),
   478→        lang=getattr(args, "lang", None),
   479→        path=getattr(args, "path", None),
   480→        exclude=getattr(args, "exclude", None),
   481→    )
   482→
   483→    cmd_resolve(resolve_args)
   484→
   485→
   486→def cmd_plan_focus(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   487→    """Set or clear the active cluster focus."""
   488→    clear_flag = getattr(args, "clear", False)
   489→    cluster_name: str | None = getattr(args, "cluster_name", None)
   490→
   491→    plan = load_plan()
   492→    if clear_flag:
   493→        prev = plan.get("active_cluster")
   494→        clear_focus(plan)
   495→        append_log_entry(
   496→            plan, "focus", actor="user",
   497→            detail={"action": "clear", "previous": prev},
   498→        )
   499→        save_plan(plan)
   500→        print(colorize("  Focus cleared.", "green"))
   501→        return
   502→
   503→    if not cluster_name:
   504→        active = plan.get("active_cluster")
   505→        if active:
   506→            print(f"  Focused on: {active}")
   507→        else:
   508→            print("  No active focus.")
   509→        return
   510→
   511→    try:
   512→        set_focus(plan, cluster_name)
   513→    except ValueError as ex:
   514→        print(colorize(f"  {ex}", "red"))
   515→        return
   516→    append_log_entry(
   517→        plan, "focus", cluster_name=cluster_name, actor="user",
   518→        detail={"action": "set"},
   519→    )
   520→    save_plan(plan)
   521→    print(colorize(f"  Focused on: {cluster_name}", "green"))
   522→

    53→def _is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    54→    """Return True for queue items that represent subjective work."""
    55→    return item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" or bool(item.get("is_subjective"))

    58→def _apply_subjective_interleave_guardrail(
    59→    items: list[dict],
    60→    *,
    61→    objective_burst: int = 3,
    62→    subjective_burst: int = 1,
    63→) -> list[dict]:
    64→    """Interleave subjective work with objective work to avoid starvation."""
    65→    if objective_burst < 1 or subjective_burst < 1:
    66→        return items
    67→
    68→    subjective_items = deque(
    69→        item for item in items if _is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    70→    )
    71→    objective_items = deque(
    72→        item for item in items if not _is_subjective_queue_item(item)
    73→    )
    74→    if not subjective_items or not objective_items:
    75→        return items
    76→
    77→    interleaved: list[dict] = []
    78→    while objective_items and subjective_items:
    79→        for _ in range(objective_burst):
    80→            if not objective_items:
    81→                break
    82→            interleaved.append(objective_items.popleft())
    83→        for _ in range(subjective_burst):
    84→            if not subjective_items:
    85→                break
    86→            interleaved.append(subjective_items.popleft())
    87→
    88→    interleaved.extend(objective_items)
    89→    interleaved.extend(subjective_items)
    90→    return interleaved

    99→    if not threshold:

   108→def _apply_plan_order(
   109→    items: list[dict],
   110→    plan: dict,
   111→    *,
   112→    include_skipped: bool = False,
   113→    cluster: str | None = None,
   114→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
   115→) -> list[dict]:
   116→    """Reorder items according to the living plan.
   117→
   118→    1. Items in ``queue_order`` appear first, in that order.
   119→    2. Existing remaining items keep their mechanical sort.
   120→    3. New items (from latest scan) sort after existing remaining items.
   121→    4. Skipped items are appended last (or excluded).
   122→    5. Each item is annotated with plan metadata.
   123→    """
   124→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   125→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   126→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   127→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
   128→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   129→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
   130→
   131→    # Build lookup
   132→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
   133→    for item in items:
   134→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
   135→
   136→    # Annotate items with plan metadata
   137→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
   138→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
   139→        if override.get("description"):
   140→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
   141→        if override.get("note"):
   142→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
   143→        if override.get("cluster"):
   144→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
   145→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   146→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
   147→                "name": cluster_name,
   148→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
   149→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
   150→                "sibling_ids": cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []),
   151→            }
   152→
   153→    # Split into ordered, remaining, skipped
   154→    ordered: list[dict] = []
   155→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
   156→    for fid in queue_order:
   157→        if fid in by_id and fid not in skipped_ids:
   158→            ordered.append(by_id[fid])
   159→            ordered_ids.add(fid)
   160→
   161→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
   162→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
   163→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
   164→    _new = new_ids or set()
   165→    for item in items:
   166→        item_id = item["id"]
   167→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
   168→            continue
   169→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
   170→            skipped_items.append(item)
   171→        elif item_id in _new:
   172→            remaining_new.append(item)
   173→        else:
   174→            remaining_existing.append(item)
   175→
   176→    # Assign queue positions — new items after existing ones
   177→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
   178→    if include_skipped:
   179→        result = result + skipped_items
   180→
   181→    for pos, item in enumerate(result):
   182→        item["queue_position"] = pos + 1
   183→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   184→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   185→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   186→            if skip_entry:
   187→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   188→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   189→                if skip_reason:
   190→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   191→
   192→    # Filter to cluster if requested
   193→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   194→    if effective_cluster:
   195→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   196→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   197→        if cluster_member_ids:
   198→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   199→
   200→    return result

   203→def _action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   204→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   205→    try:

   207→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)

   215→def _collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   216→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items."""
   217→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   218→    if not clusters:
   219→        return items
   220→
   221→    # Build mapping: finding_id → auto-cluster name
   222→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   223→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   224→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   225→            continue
   226→        for fid in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   227→            fid_to_cluster[fid] = name
   228→
   229→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   230→        return items
   231→
   232→    # Collect members for each cluster, preserving order
   233→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   234→    non_cluster_items: list[dict] = []
   235→
   236→    for item in items:
   237→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   238→        if cname:
   239→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   240→        else:
   241→            non_cluster_items.append(item)
   242→
   243→    # Build cluster meta-items
   244→    result: list[dict] = list(non_cluster_items)
   245→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   246→        # Don't collapse singletons — show them as individual findings
   247→        if len(members) < 2:
   248→            result.extend(members)
   249→            continue
   250→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cname, {})
   251→        detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   252→        action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   253→        # Derive action_type from the actual cluster action, not just the detector
   254→        if "desloppify fix" in action:
   255→            action_type = "auto_fix"
   256→        elif "desloppify move" in action:
   257→            action_type = "reorganize"
   258→        else:
   259→            action_type = _action_type_for_detector(detector)
   260→            # If detector says auto_fix but cluster has no fix command, it's really refactor
   261→            if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   262→                action_type = "refactor"
   263→
   264→        # Use stored description but patch the count if it differs from visible members
   265→        stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   266→        total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   267→        if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   268→            # Replace the stored count with the visible count
   269→            summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   270→        else:
   271→            summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   272→
   273→        primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   274→        if not primary_command:
   275→            primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cname} --count 10"
   276→
   277→        meta_item: dict = {

   298→def build_work_queue(

   301→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
   302→) -> WorkQueueResult:
   303→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
   304→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   305→
   306→    status = resolved_options.status
   307→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   308→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   309→    try:
   310→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
   311→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   312→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
   313→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
   314→
   315→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
   316→        state,
   317→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
   318→        status_filter=status,
   319→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
   320→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
   321→    )
   322→
   323→    all_items = list(finding_items)
   324→    has_objective_backlog = bool(finding_items)
   325→    suppressed_count = 0
   326→    if (
   327→        resolved_options.include_subjective
   328→        and status in {"open", "all"}
   329→        and not resolved_options.chronic
   330→    ):
   331→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   332→            state,
   333→            state.get("findings", {}),
   334→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   335→        )
   336→        for item in subjective_items:
   337→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   338→                continue
   339→            # Suppress subjective items whose only action is a review rerun
   340→            # (--force-review-rerun) while objective backlog exists — the
   341→            # review preflight blocks reruns until the backlog drains.
   342→            if has_objective_backlog and item.get("backlog_gated"):
   343→                suppressed_count += 1

   347→    # Inject synthesis stage items and workflow items when plan requires it

   367→        )

   383→        and not resolved_options.scope
   384→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   385→    )
