```
    58→def is_auto_fix_command(command: str | None) -> bool:
    59→    cmd = (command or "").strip()
    60→    return cmd.startswith("desloppify fix ") and "--dry-run" in cmd
    61→
    62→
    63→def _effort_tag(item: dict) -> str:
    64→    """Return a short effort/type tag for a queue item."""
    65→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
    66→        return "[review]"
    67→    if is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
    68→        return "[auto]"
    69→    return ""
    70→
    71→
    72→_ACTION_TYPE_LABELS = {
    73→    "auto_fix": "Auto-fixable batch",
    74→    "reorganize": "Reorganize batch",
    75→    "refactor": "Refactor batch",
    76→    "manual_fix": "Grouped task",
    77→}
    78→
    79→
    80→def _render_cluster_item(item: dict) -> None:
    81→    """Render an auto-cluster task card."""
    82→    member_count = int(item.get("member_count", 0))
    83→    action_type = item.get("action_type", "manual_fix")
    84→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
    85→    is_optional = bool(item.get("cluster_optional"))
    86→    if cluster_name == "auto/initial-review":
    87→        type_label = "Initial subjective review"
    88→    elif cluster_name == "auto/stale-review":
    89→        type_label = "Stale subjective review"
    90→    elif cluster_name == "auto/under-target-review":
    91→        type_label = "Optional re-review"
    92→    else:
    93→        type_label = _ACTION_TYPE_LABELS.get(action_type, "Grouped task")
    94→    optional_tag = " — optional" if is_optional else ""
    95→    print(colorize(f"  ({type_label}, {member_count} findings{optional_tag})", "bold"))
    96→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
    97→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
    98→
    99→    # Show breakdown by file (compact) + representative members
   100→    members = item.get("members", [])
   101→    if members:
   102→        # File distribution
   103→        file_counts = Counter(m.get("file", "?") for m in members)
   104→        if len(file_counts) <= 5:
   105→            print(colorize("\n  Files:", "dim"))
   106→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common():
   107→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   108→        else:
   109→            print(colorize(f"\n  Spread across {len(file_counts)} files:", "dim"))
   110→            for f, c in file_counts.most_common(3):
   111→                print(f"    {f} ({c})")
   112→            remaining = len(file_counts) - 3
   113→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {remaining} more files", "dim"))
   114→
   115→        # Sample IDs
   116→        print(colorize("\n  Sample:", "dim"))
   117→        for m in members[:3]:
   118→            print(f"    - {m.get('id', '')}")
   119→        if len(members) > 3:
   120→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(members) - 3} more", "dim"))
   121→
   122→    # Action
   123→    cluster_name = item.get("id", "")
   124→    primary_command = item.get("primary_command")
   125→    if primary_command:
   126→        print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {primary_command}", "cyan"))
   127→
   128→    # Resolution hints
   129→    if is_optional:
   130→        print(colorize(f"\n  Skip:          desloppify plan skip {cluster_name}", "dim"))
   131→        print(colorize(f"  Drill in:      desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10",
   132→                       "dim"))
   133→        print(colorize(f'  Resolve all:   desloppify plan done "{cluster_name}" '
   134→                       f'--note "<what>" --confirm', "dim"))
   135→    else:
   136→        print(colorize(f'\n  Resolve all:   desloppify plan done "{cluster_name}" '
   137→                       f'--note "<what>" --confirm', "dim"))
   138→        print(colorize(f"  Drill in:      desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10",
   139→                       "dim"))
   140→        print(colorize(f"  Skip cluster:  desloppify plan skip {cluster_name}", "dim"))
   141→
   142→
   143→def _render_item(
   144→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, findings_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   145→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   146→) -> None:
   147→    # Delegate to cluster renderer for cluster meta-items
   148→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   149→        _render_cluster_item(item)
   150→        return
   151→
   152→    # Workflow stage item (synthesis stages)
   153→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage":
   154→        blocked = item.get("is_blocked", False)
   155→        stage = item.get("stage_name", "")
   156→        tag = " [blocked]" if blocked else ""
   157→        style = "dim" if blocked else "bold"
   158→        print(colorize(f"  (Planning stage: {stage}{tag})", style))
   159→        print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   160→        print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   161→        detail = item.get("detail", {})
   162→        total = detail.get("total_review_findings", 0)
   163→        if total:
   164→            print(colorize(f"  {total} review findings to analyze", "dim"))
   165→        if blocked:
   166→            blocked_by = item.get("blocked_by", [])
   167→            deps = ", ".join(b.replace("synthesis::", "") for b in blocked_by)
   168→            print(colorize(f"  Blocked by: {deps}", "dim"))
   169→        else:
   170→            print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {item.get('primary_command', '')}", "cyan"))
   171→        return
   172→
   173→    # Workflow action item (e.g. create-plan)
   174→    if item.get("kind") == "workflow_action":
   175→        print(colorize("  (Workflow step)", "bold"))
   176→        print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   177→        print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   178→        print(colorize(f"\n  Action: {item.get('primary_command', '')}", "cyan"))
   179→        return
   180→
   181→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   182→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   183→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   184→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   185→
   186→    # Effort/type label
   187→    if item.get("detector") == "review":
   188→        print(colorize("  Type: Design review (requires judgment)", "dim"))
   189→    elif is_auto_fix_command(item.get("primary_command")):
   190→        print(colorize("  Type: Auto-fixable", "dim"))
   191→
   192→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   193→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
   194→        detail = item.get("detail", {})
   195→        subjective_score = float(
   196→            detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
   197→        )
   198→        print(f"  Dimension: {detail.get('dimension_name', 'unknown')}")
   199→        print(f"  Score: {subjective_score:.1f}%")
   200→        print(
   201→            colorize(
   202→                f"  Action: {item.get('primary_command', 'desloppify review --prepare')}",
   203→                "cyan",
   204→            )
   205→        )
   206→        print(colorize(
   207→            "  Note: re-review scores what it finds — scores can go down if issues are discovered.",
   208→            "dim",
   209→        ))
   210→        if explain:
   211→            reason = item.get("explain", {}).get(
   212→                "policy",
   213→                "subjective items sort after mechanical items at the same level.",
   214→            )
   215→            print(colorize(f"  explain: {reason}", "dim"))
   216→        return
   217→
   218→    # Plan overrides: description, cluster, note
   219→    if item.get("plan_description"):
   220→        print(colorize(f"  → {item['plan_description']}", "cyan"))
   221→    plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   222→    if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict):
   223→        cluster_name = plan_cluster.get("name", "")
   224→        cluster_desc = plan_cluster.get("description") or ""
   225→        total = plan_cluster.get("total_items", 0)
   226→        desc_str = f' — "{cluster_desc}"' if cluster_desc else ""
   227→        print(colorize(f"  Cluster: {cluster_name}{desc_str} ({total} items)", "dim"))
   228→    if item.get("plan_note"):
   229→        print(colorize(f"  Note: {item['plan_note']}", "dim"))
   230→
   231→    print(f"  File: {item.get('file', '')}")
   232→    print(colorize(f"  ID:   {item.get('id', '')}", "dim"))
   233→
   234→    detail = item.get("detail", {})
   235→    if isinstance(detail, str):
   236→        detail = {"suggestion": detail}
   237→    if isinstance(detail, dict):
   238→        detail.setdefault("lines", [])
   239→        detail.setdefault("line", None)
   240→        detail.setdefault("category", None)
   241→        detail.setdefault("importers", None)
   242→        detail.setdefault("count", 0)
   243→    if detail.get("lines"):
   244→        print(f"  Lines: {', '.join(str(line_no) for line_no in detail['lines'][:8])}")
   245→    if detail.get("category"):
   246→        print(f"  Category: {detail['category']}")
   247→    if detail.get("importers") is not None:
   248→        print(f"  Active importers: {detail['importers']}")
   249→    if detail.get("suggestion"):
   250→        print(colorize(f"\n  Suggestion: {detail['suggestion']}", "dim"))
   251→
   252→    target_line = detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
   253→    if target_line and item.get("file") not in (".", ""):
   254→        snippet = read_code_snippet(item["file"], target_line)
   255→        if snippet:
   256→            print(colorize("\n  Code:", "dim"))
   257→            print(snippet)
   258→
   259→    if dim_scores:
   260→        detector = item.get("detector", "")
   261→        dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   262→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   263→            dimension_score = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   264→            strict_val = dimension_score.get("strict", dimension_score["score"])
   265→            print(
   266→                colorize(
   267→                    f"\n  Dimension: {dimension.name} — {dimension_score['score']:.1f}% "
   268→                    f"(strict: {strict_val:.1f}%) "
   269→                    f"({dimension_score['issues']} of {dimension_score['checks']:,} checks failing)",
   270→                    "dim",
   271→                )
   272→            )
   273→
   274→    # Score impact estimate
   275→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   276→    if potentials and detector and dim_scores:
   277→        try:
   278→            impact = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=1)
   279→            if impact > 0:
   280→                print(colorize(f"  Impact: fixing this is worth ~+{impact:.1f} pts on overall score", "cyan"))
   281→            else:
   282→                # Single-item impact rounds to 0 — try bulk impact for all issues in detector
   283→                dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   284→                if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   285→                    issues = dim_scores[dimension.name].get("issues", 0)
   286→                    if issues > 1:
   287→                        bulk = compute_score_impact(dim_scores, potentials, detector, issues_to_fix=issues)
   288→                        if bulk > 0:
   289→                            print(colorize(
   290→                                f"  Impact: fixing all {issues} {detector} issues → ~+{bulk:.1f} pts",
   291→                                "cyan",
   292→                            ))
   293→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   294→            log(f"  score impact estimate skipped: {exc}")
   295→    elif detector == "review" and dim_scores:
   296→        # Review findings: show dimension drag from breakdown
   297→        try:
   298→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   299→            if dim_key:
   300→                breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   301→                for entry in breakdown.get("entries", []):
   302→                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   303→                        continue
   304→                    entry_key = str(entry.get("name", "")).lower().replace(" ", "_")
   305→                    if entry_key == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   306→                        drag = float(entry.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   307→                        if drag > 0.01:
   308→                            print(colorize(
   309→                                f"  Dimension drag: {entry['name']} costs -{drag:.2f} pts on overall score",
   310→                                "cyan",
   311→                            ))
   312→                        break
   313→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   314→            log(f"  dimension drag estimate skipped: {exc}")
   315→
   316→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   317→    auto_fix_command = item.get("primary_command")
   318→    if is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   319→        similar_count = sum(
   320→            1
   321→            for finding in findings_scoped.values()
   322→            if finding.get("detector") == detector_name and finding["status"] == "open"
   323→        )
   324→        if similar_count > 1:
   325→            print(
   326→                colorize(
   327→                    f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar findings. "
   328→                    f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   329→                    "cyan",
   330→                )
   331→            )
   332→    if explain:
   333→        explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   334→        count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   335→        base = (
   336→            f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   337→            f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   338→        )
   339→
   340→        # Add dimension context for mechanical detectors
   341→        if dim_scores and detector:
   342→            dimension = scoring_mod.get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   343→            if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   344→                ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   345→                base += (
   346→                    f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   347→                    f"({ds['issues']} open issues)"
   348→                )
   349→
   350→        # For review findings, show subjective dimension context
   351→        if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   352→            dim_key = item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")
   353→            if dim_key:
   354→                for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   355→                    if ds_name.lower().replace(" ", "_") == dim_key.lower().replace(" ", "_"):
   356→                        score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   357→                        score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}" if isinstance(score_val, (int, float)) else str(score_val)
   358→                        base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   359→                        break
   360→
   361→        policy = explanation.get("policy")
   362→        if policy:
   363→            base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   364→        print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))

   380→def show_empty_queue(
   381→    queue: dict,
   382→    strict: float | None,
   383→    *,
   384→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   385→    target_strict: float | None = None,
   386→) -> bool:
   387→    if queue.get("items"):
   388→        return False
   389→    # Show before/after comparison when plan_start_strict is available
   390→    if plan_start_strict is not None and strict is not None:
   391→        delta = round(strict - plan_start_strict, 1)
   392→        delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
   393→        print(colorize("\n  Queue cleared!", "green"))
   394→        print(colorize(
   395→            f"  Frozen plan-start: strict {plan_start_strict:.1f} → Live estimate: strict {strict:.1f}{delta_str}",
   396→            "cyan",
   397→        ))
   398→        print(colorize(
   399→            "  Run `desloppify scan` now to finalize and reveal your updated score.",
   400→            "dim",
   401→        ))
   402→    else:
   403→        suffix = f" Strict score: {strict:.1f}/100" if strict is not None else ""
   404→        print(colorize(f"\n  Nothing to do!{suffix}", "green"))
   405→    return True

   408→def _render_compact_item(item: dict, idx: int, total: int) -> None:
   409→    """One-line summary for cluster drill-in items after the first."""
   410→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   411→    tag = _effort_tag(item)
   412→    tag_str = f" {tag}" if tag else ""
   413→    fid = item.get("id", "")
   414→    short = fid.rsplit("::", 1)[-1][:8] if "::" in fid else fid
   415→    print(f"  [{idx + 1}/{total}] [{confidence}]{tag_str} {item.get('summary', '')}")
   416→    print(colorize(f"         {item.get('file', '')}  [{short}]", "dim"))

   419→def render_terminal_items(
   420→    items: list[dict],
   421→    dim_scores: dict,
   422→    findings_scoped: dict,
   423→    *,
   424→    group: str,
   425→    explain: bool,
   426→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   427→    plan: dict | None = None,
   428→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   429→) -> None:
   430→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster
   431→    if plan and plan.get("active_cluster"):
   432→        cluster_name = plan["active_cluster"]
   433→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   434→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   435→        total = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   436→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   437→
   438→    if group != "item":
   439→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   440→        return
   441→
   442→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   443→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   444→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   445→    )
   446→
   447→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   448→        if idx > 0:
   449→            print()
   450→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   451→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   452→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   453→            continue
   454→        queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   455→        if queue_pos and len(items) > 1:
   456→            label = f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   457→        elif len(items) > 1:
   458→            label = f"  [{idx + 1}/{len(items)}]"
   459→        else:
   460→            pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   461→            label = f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   462→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   463→        _render_item(item, dim_scores, findings_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials)
   464→

   466→def render_single_item_resolution_hint(items: list[dict]) -> None:
   467→    if len(items) != 1:
   468→        return
   469→    kind = items[0].get("kind", "finding")
   470→    if kind in ("cluster", "workflow_stage", "workflow_action"):
   471→        return  # These kinds have their own resolution hints
   472→    if kind != "finding":
   473→        return
   474→    item = items[0]
   475→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   476→    if detector_name == "subjective_review":
   477→        print(colorize("\n  Review with:", "dim"))
   478→        primary = item.get(
   479→            "primary_command", "desloppify show subjective"
   480→        )
   481→        print(f"    {primary}")
   482→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   483→            print("    desloppify review --prepare")
   484→        return
   485→
   486→    primary = item.get("primary_command", "")
   487→    if is_auto_fix_command(primary):
   488→        print(colorize("\n  Fix with:", "dim"))
   489→        print(f"    {primary}")
   490→        print(colorize("  Or resolve individually:", "dim"))
   491→    else:
   492→        print(colorize("\n  Resolve with:", "dim"))

   494→    print(
   495→        f'    desloppify plan done "{item["id"]}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'

   497→    print(

   503→def render_followup_nudges(
   504→    state: dict,
   505→    dim_scores: dict,
   506→    findings_scoped: dict,
   507→    *,
   508→    strict_score: float | None,
   509→    target_strict_score: float,
   510→    queue_total: int = 0,
   511→    plan_start_strict: float | None = None,
   512→    breakdown: "QueueBreakdown | None" = None,
   513→) -> None:
   514→    from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   515→        format_queue_block,
   516→    )
   517→
   518→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   519→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   520→    followup = build_subjective_followup(
   521→        state,
   522→        subjective_entries,
   523→        threshold=subjective_threshold,
   524→        max_quality_items=3,
   525→        max_integrity_items=5,
   526→    )
   527→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   528→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   529→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   530→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   531→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   532→        print()
   533→        for text, style in block:
   534→            print(colorize(text, style))
   535→        print(colorize(
   536→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   537→            "dim",
   538→        ))
   539→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   540→        print(
   541→            colorize(
   542→                f"\n  Score (frozen at plan start): strict {plan_start_strict:.1f}/100",
   543→                "cyan",
   544→            )
   545→        )
   546→        print(
   547→            colorize(
   548→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   549→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   550→                "dim",
   551→            )
   552→        )
   553→    elif strict_score is not None:
   554→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   555→        if gap > 0:
   556→            print(
   557→                colorize(
   558→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 → target {target_strict_score:.1f} (+{gap:.1f} needed)",
   559→                    "cyan",
   560→                )
   561→            )
   562→        else:
   563→            print(
   564→                colorize(
   565→                    f"\n  North star: strict {strict_score:.1f}/100 meets target {target_strict_score:.1f}",
   566→                    "green",
   567→                )
   568→            )
   569→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   570→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   571→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   572→        for text, style in block:
   573→            print(colorize(text, style))
   574→
   575→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   576→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   577→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   578→    _objective_remaining = max(
   579→        0,
   580→        (breakdown.queue_total - breakdown.subjective) if breakdown else queue_total,
   581→    )
   582→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   583→        try:
   584→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   585→            subjective_drag = sum(
   586→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   587→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   588→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") == "subjective"
   589→            )
   590→            mechanical_drag = sum(
   591→                float(e.get("overall_drag", 0) or 0)
   592→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])
   593→                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("component") != "subjective"
   594→            )
   595→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   596→                print(colorize(
   597→                    f"\n  Subjective dimensions are the main bottleneck "
   598→                    f"(-{subjective_drag:.0f} pts vs -{mechanical_drag:.0f} pts mechanical).",
   599→                    "yellow",
   600→                ))
   601→                print(colorize(
   602→                    "  Code fixes alone won't close the gap — run "
   603→                    "`desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` "
   604→                    "to re-score.",
   605→                    "yellow",
   606→                ))
   607→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
   608→            log(f"  subjective bottleneck banner skipped: {exc}")
   609→
   610→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   611→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:
   612→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   613→
   614→    # Rescan nudge after structural work
   615→    if queue_total > 10:
   616→        print(colorize(
   617→            "\n  Tip: after structural fixes (splitting files, moving code), rescan to "
   618→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",
   619→            "dim",
   620→        ))
   621→
   622→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   623→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   624→        findings_scoped
   625→    )
   626→    parts: list[str] = []
   627→    low_dims = len(followup.low_assessed)
   628→    unassessed_count = len(unassessed_subjective)
   629→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))
   630→    open_review = [
   631→        f for f in findings_scoped.values()
   632→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") == "review"
   633→    ]
   634→    if low_dims:
   635→        parts.append(f"{low_dims} dimension{'s' if low_dims != 1 else ''} below target")
   636→    if stale_count:
   637→        parts.append(f"{stale_count} stale")
   638→    if unassessed_count:
   639→        parts.append(f"{unassessed_count} unassessed")
   640→    if len(open_review):
   641→        parts.append(f"{len(open_review)} review finding{'s' if len(open_review) != 1 else ''} open")
   642→    if coverage_open > 0:
   643→        parts.append(f"{coverage_open} file{'s' if coverage_open != 1 else ''} need review")
   644→
   645→    if parts:
   646→        print(colorize(f"\n  Subjective: {', '.join(parts)}.", "cyan"))
   647→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
   648→
```

```
   135→def _migrate_deferred_to_skipped(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   136→    deferred: list[str] = plan["deferred"]
   137→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   138→    if not deferred:
   139→        return
   140→
   141→    now = utc_now()
   142→    for fid in list(deferred):
   143→        if fid in skipped:
   144→            continue
   145→        skipped[fid] = {
   146→            "finding_id": fid,
   147→            "kind": "temporary",
   148→            "reason": None,
   149→            "note": None,
   150→            "attestation": None,
   151→            "created_at": now,
   152→            "review_after": None,
   153→            "skipped_at_scan": 0,
   154→        }
   155→    deferred.clear()
   156→
   157→
   158→def _normalize_cluster_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   159→    for cluster in plan["clusters"].values():
   160→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict):
   161→            continue
   162→        if not isinstance(cluster.get("finding_ids"), list):
   163→            cluster["finding_ids"] = []
   164→        cluster.setdefault("auto", False)
   165→        cluster.setdefault("cluster_key", "")
   166→        cluster.setdefault("action", None)
   167→        cluster.setdefault("user_modified", False)

   170→def _migrate_epics_to_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   171→    """Migrate v3 top-level ``epics`` dict into ``clusters`` (v4 unification)."""
   172→    epics = plan.pop("epics", None)
   173→    if not isinstance(epics, dict) or not epics:
   174→        return
   175→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   176→    now = utc_now()
   177→    for name, epic in epics.items():
   178→        if not isinstance(epic, dict):
   179→            continue
   180→        if name in clusters:
   181→            continue  # don't overwrite existing cluster
   182→        clusters[name] = {
   183→            "name": name,
   184→            "description": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   185→            "finding_ids": epic.get("finding_ids", []),
   186→            "auto": True,
   187→            "cluster_key": f"epic::{name}",
   188→            "action": f"desloppify plan focus {name}",
   189→            "user_modified": False,
   190→            "created_at": epic.get("created_at", now),
   191→            "updated_at": epic.get("updated_at", now),
   192→            # Epic-specific fields
   193→            "thesis": epic.get("thesis", ""),
   194→            "direction": epic.get("direction", "simplify"),
   195→            "root_cause": epic.get("root_cause", ""),
   196→            "supersedes": epic.get("supersedes", []),
   197→            "dismissed": epic.get("dismissed", []),
   198→            "agent_safe": epic.get("agent_safe", False),
   199→            "dependency_order": epic.get("dependency_order", 999),
   200→            "action_steps": epic.get("action_steps", []),
   201→            "source_clusters": epic.get("source_clusters", []),
   202→            "status": epic.get("status", "pending"),
   203→            "synthesis_version": epic.get("synthesis_version", 0),
   204→        }
   205→
   206→
   207→def _migrate_v5_to_v6(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   208→    """Migrate v5 → v6: unified queue system.
   209→
   210→    - ``synthesis::pending`` → 4 individual stage IDs
   211→    - ``pending_plan_gate = True`` → ``workflow::create-plan`` queue item
   212→    - Remove ``pending_plan_gate`` key
   213→    """
   214→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   215→        SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS,
   216→        WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID,
   217→    )
   218→
   219→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   220→
   221→    # --- synthesis::pending → 4 stage IDs ----------------------------------
   222→    if "synthesis::pending" in order:
   223→        idx = order.index("synthesis::pending")
   224→        order.remove("synthesis::pending")
   225→        # Only inject stages not already confirmed in meta
   226→        meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   227→        confirmed = set(meta.get("synthesis_stages", {}).keys())
   228→        stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   229→        to_inject = [
   230→            sid for sid, name in zip(SYNTHESIS_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)
   231→            if name not in confirmed and sid not in order
   232→        ]
   233→        for i, sid in enumerate(to_inject):
   234→            order.insert(idx + i, sid)
   235→
   236→    # --- pending_plan_gate → workflow::create-plan --------------------------
   237→    if plan.pop("pending_plan_gate", False):
   238→        if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID not in order:
   239→            # Insert after any synthesis stages, before findings
   240→            insert_at = 0
   241→            for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   242→                if fid.startswith("synthesis::"):
   243→                    insert_at = i + 1
   244→            order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   245→    else:
   246→        plan.pop("pending_plan_gate", None)
   247→
   248→
   249→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   250→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   251→
   252→    Handles migration from v1 (deferred list) to v2 (skipped dict),
   253→    v3 (top-level epics) to v4 (epics unified into clusters),
   254→    and v5 (gates) to v6 (unified queue).
   255→    """
   256→    defaults = empty_plan()
   257→    for key, value in defaults.items():
   258→        plan.setdefault(key, value)
   259→
   260→    _ensure_container_types(plan)
   261→    _migrate_deferred_to_skipped(plan)
   262→    _migrate_epics_to_clusters(plan)
   263→    _normalize_cluster_defaults(plan)
   264→    _migrate_v5_to_v6(plan)
   265→
   266→
   267→def synthesis_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   268→    """Return clusters whose name starts with ``EPIC_PREFIX``."""
   269→    return {
   270→        name: cluster
   271→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   272→        if name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   273→    }
   274→
   275→
   276→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   277→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   278→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   279→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   280→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   281→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   282→
   283→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   284→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   285→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   286→    if overlap:
   287→        raise ValueError(
   288→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   289→        )
   290→
   291→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   292→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   293→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   294→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   295→            raise ValueError(
   296→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   297→            )
   298→
```

```
     2→

    13→from desloppify.core._internal.text_utils import is_numeric
    14→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import _matches_pattern
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import (

    24→def coerce_assessment_score(value: object) -> float | None:
    25→    """Normalize a subjective assessment score payload to a 0-100 float.
    26→
    27→    Returns ``None`` when the value cannot be interpreted as a numeric score
    28→    (e.g. bools, non-numeric strings, missing keys).
    29→    """
    30→    if is_numeric(value):
    31→        return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value))), 1)
    32→    if isinstance(value, dict):
    33→        raw = value.get("score")
    34→        if not is_numeric(raw):
    35→            return None
    36→        return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(raw))), 1)
    37→    return None
    38→
    39→
    40→def _mark_stale_assessments_on_review_resolve(
    41→    state: StateModel,
    42→    *,
    43→    status: str,
    44→    resolved_findings: list[dict],
    45→    now: str,
    46→) -> None:
    47→    """Mark subjective assessments as stale when review findings are resolved.
    48→
    49→    The assessment score is preserved (not zeroed) — only a fresh review import
    50→    should change dimension scores.  The stale marker tells the UI to prompt
    51→    for a re-review.
    52→    """
    53→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    54→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    55→        return
    56→
    57→    touched_dimensions: set[str] = set()
    58→    for finding in resolved_findings:
    59→        if finding.get("detector") != "review":
    60→            continue
    61→        dimension = str(finding.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")).strip()
    62→        if dimension:
    63→            touched_dimensions.add(dimension)
    64→
    65→    for dimension in sorted(touched_dimensions):
    66→        if dimension not in assessments:
    67→            continue
    68→
    69→        payload = assessments.get(dimension)
    70→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
    71→            payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    72→            payload["refresh_reason"] = f"review_finding_{status}"
    73→            payload["stale_since"] = now
    74→        else:
    75→            assessments[dimension] = {
    76→                "score": coerce_assessment_score(payload) or 0.0,
    77→                "needs_review_refresh": True,
    78→                "refresh_reason": f"review_finding_{status}",
    79→                "stale_since": now,
    80→            }
    81→
    82→
    83→def match_findings(
    84→    state: StateModel, pattern: str, status_filter: str = "open"
    85→) -> list[dict]:
    86→    """Return findings matching *pattern* with the given status."""
    87→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
    88→    return [
    89→        finding
    90→        for finding_id, finding in state["findings"].items()
    91→        if not finding.get("suppressed")
    92→        if (status_filter == "all" or finding["status"] == status_filter)
    93→        and _matches_pattern(finding_id, finding, pattern)
    94→    ]
    95→

    97→def resolve_findings(
    98→    state: StateModel,
    99→    pattern: str,
   100→    status: str,
   101→    note: str | None = None,
   102→    attestation: str | None = None,
   103→) -> list[str]:
   104→    """Set finding status for matches and return affected finding IDs."""
   105→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   106→    now = utc_now()
   107→    resolved: list[str] = []
   108→    resolved_findings: list[dict] = []
   109→    status_filter = "all" if status == "open" else "open"
   110→    for finding in match_findings(state, pattern, status_filter=status_filter):
   111→        previous_status = str(finding.get("status", "open")).strip() or "open"
   112→        if status == "open" and previous_status == "open":
   113→            continue
   114→
   115→        extra_updates: dict[str, object] = {}
   116→        if status == "wontfix":
   117→            snapshot_scan_count = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   118→            extra_updates["wontfix_scan_count"] = snapshot_scan_count
   119→            extra_updates["wontfix_snapshot"] = {
   120→                "captured_at": now,
   121→                "scan_count": snapshot_scan_count,
   122→                "tier": finding.get("tier"),
   123→                "confidence": finding.get("confidence"),
   124→                "detail": copy.deepcopy(finding.get("detail", {})),
   125→            }
   126→        if status == "open":
   127→            finding["reopen_count"] = int(finding.get("reopen_count", 0) or 0) + 1
   128→            finding.pop("wontfix_scan_count", None)
   129→            finding.pop("wontfix_snapshot", None)
   130→            previous_note = finding.get("note")
   131→            next_note = note if note is not None else previous_note
   132→            extra_updates["resolved_at"] = None
   133→            extra_updates["note"] = next_note
   134→            reopen_attestation = {
   135→                "kind": "manual_reopen",
   136→                "text": attestation or note,
   137→                "attested_at": now,
   138→                "scan_verified": False,
   139→            }
   140→            reopen_attestation["previous_status"] = previous_status
   141→            extra_updates["resolution_attestation"] = reopen_attestation
   142→
   143→        updates: dict[str, object] = {
   144→            "status": status,
   145→            "note": note,
   146→            "resolved_at": now,
   147→            "suppressed": False,
   148→            "suppressed_at": None,
   149→            "suppression_pattern": None,
   150→            "resolution_attestation": {
   151→                "kind": "manual",
   152→                "text": attestation,
   153→                "attested_at": now,
   154→                "scan_verified": False,
   155→            },
   156→        }
   157→        updates.update(extra_updates)
   158→        finding.update(updates)
   159→        resolved.append(finding["id"])
   160→        resolved_findings.append(finding)
   161→
   162→    _mark_stale_assessments_on_review_resolve(
   163→        state,
   164→        status=status,
   165→        resolved_findings=resolved_findings,
   166→        now=now,
   167→    )
   168→
   169→    _recompute_stats(state, scan_path=state.get("scan_path"))
   170→    validate_state_invariants(state)
   171→    return resolved
   172→
```

```
    19→def dimension_cli_key(dimension_name: str) -> str:
    20→    """Map a display name to a review --dimensions CLI key."""
    21→    cleaned = dimension_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
    22→    lowered = cleaned.lower()
    23→    if lowered in _COMPONENT_TO_DIMENSION:
    24→        return _COMPONENT_TO_DIMENSION[lowered]
    25→    for key, display in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
    26→        if display.lower() == lowered:
    27→            return key
    28→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", lowered).strip("_")
    29→
    30→
    31→def scorecard_dimension_cli_keys(name: str, data: dict) -> list[str]:
    32→    """Map scorecard subjective display names to review --dimensions keys."""
    33→    if name in ("Elegance", "Elegance (combined)"):
    34→        components = (
    35→            data.get("detectors", {})
    36→            .get("subjective_assessment", {})
    37→            .get("components", [])
    38→        )
    39→        if isinstance(components, list) and components:
    40→            keys = [dimension_cli_key(component) for component in components]
    41→        else:
    42→            keys = [
    43→                "high_level_elegance",
    44→                "mid_level_elegance",
    45→                "low_level_elegance",
    46→            ]
    47→    elif name in ("Abstraction fit", "Abstraction fit (combined)"):
    48→        components = (
    49→            data.get("detectors", {})
    50→            .get("subjective_assessment", {})
    51→            .get("components", [])

    53→        if isinstance(components, list) and components:
    54→            keys = [dimension_cli_key(component) for component in components]
    55→        else:
    56→            keys = ["abstraction_fitness"]
    57→    else:
    58→        keys = [dimension_cli_key(name)]
    59→
    60→    seen: set[str] = set()
    61→    ordered: list[str] = []
    62→    for key in keys:
    63→        if not key or key in seen:
    64→            continue
    65→        ordered.append(key)
```

```
    20→def _compute_fp_rates(findings: dict) -> dict[tuple[str, str], float]:
    21→    """Compute false_positive rate per (detector, zone) from historical findings."""
    22→    counts: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, int]] = {}
    23→    for finding in findings.values():
    24→        detector = finding.get("detector", "unknown")
    25→        if detector in STRUCTURAL_MERGE:
    26→            detector = "structural"
    27→        zone = finding.get("zone", "production")
    28→        key = (detector, zone)
    29→        if key not in counts:
    30→            counts[key] = {"total": 0, "fp": 0}
    31→        counts[key]["total"] += 1
    32→        if finding.get("status") == "false_positive":
    33→            counts[key]["fp"] += 1
    34→
    35→    rates: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    36→    for key, stat in counts.items():
    37→        if stat["total"] >= 5 and stat["fp"] > 0:
    38→            rates[key] = stat["fp"] / stat["total"]
    39→    return rates
    40→
    41→
    42→def _auto_fixer_reminder(actions: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    43→    auto_fix_actions = [
    44→        action for action in actions if action.get("type") == "auto_fix"
    45→    ]
    46→    if not auto_fix_actions:
    47→        return []
    48→    total = sum(action.get("count", 0) for action in auto_fix_actions)
    49→    if total <= 0:
    50→        return []
    51→    first_cmd = auto_fix_actions[0].get("command", "desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run")
    52→    return [
    53→        {
    54→            "type": "auto_fixers_available",
    55→            "message": f"{total} findings are auto-fixable. Run `{first_cmd}`.",
    56→            "command": first_cmd,
    57→        }
    58→    ]
```

```
    55→def _mark_stale_on_mechanical_change(
    56→    state: StateModel,
    57→    *,
    58→    changed_detectors: set[str],
    59→    now: str,
    60→) -> None:
    61→    """Mark subjective assessments stale when mechanical findings change.
    62→
    63→    Only marks dimensions that already have an assessment — doesn't create
    64→    new entries for dimensions that have never been reviewed.
    65→    """
    66→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    67→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    68→        return
    69→
    70→    affected_dims: set[str] = set()
    71→    for detector in changed_detectors:
    72→        dims = _DETECTOR_SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSIONS.get(detector, ())
    73→        affected_dims.update(dims)
    74→
    75→    if not affected_dims:
    76→        return
    77→
    78→    for dimension in sorted(affected_dims):
    79→        if dimension not in assessments:
    80→            continue
    81→        payload = assessments[dimension]
    82→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    83→            continue
    84→        # Don't overwrite if already stale
    85→        if payload.get("needs_review_refresh"):
    86→            continue
    87→        payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    88→        payload["refresh_reason"] = "mechanical_findings_changed"
    89→        payload["stale_since"] = now
    90→
```

```
316→def sync_synthesis_needed(
   317→    plan: PlanModel,
   318→    state: StateModel,
   319→) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
   320→    """Inject 4 synthesis stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   321→
   322→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_synthesis_meta``.
   323→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion removes them.
   324→    """
   325→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   326→    result = SynthesisSyncResult()
   327→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   328→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   329→    confirmed = set(meta.get("synthesis_stages", {}).keys())
   330→

   332→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in SYNTHESIS_IDS)
   333→
   334→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   335→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   336→
   337→    # If hash changed and no stages present, inject unconfirmed stages
   338→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   339→        insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   340→        stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")

   345→                order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   346→                injected_count += 1
   347→        if injected_count:

   350→    return result
```

## Analysis Report: `workflow::create-plan` Lifecycle

### 1. **INJECTION POINTS** ✓

The item gets injected via `sync_create_plan_needed()` in three places:

#### A. Post-scan reconciliation (`scan_workflow.py:238-249`)

```python
if create_plan_sync.changes:
    dirty = True

        print("  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.")
```

#### B. Post-review import (`import_cmd.py:205-211`)
```python

if create_plan_result.injected:
    print("  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued. Run `desloppify plan`.")
```

#### C. Sync conditions in `stale_dimensions.py:364-409`

The injection only occurs when **ALL** conditions are met:

```python
def sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state):
    # 1. Item not already in queue
    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
        return result
    
    # 2. No synthesis stages pending
    if any(sid in order for sid in SYNTHESIS_IDS):
        return result
    
    # 3. NO unscored dimensions remain (all initial reviews done)
    unscored = _current_unscored_ids(state)
    if unscored:
        return result
    
    # 4. At least one objective finding exists
    has_objective = any(
        f.get("status") == "open"
        and f.get("detector") not in ("review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment")
        for f in findings.values()
    )
    if not has_objective:
        return result
    
    # Insert after subjective/synthesis items
    insert_at = 0
    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(SYNTHESIS_PREFIX):
            insert_at = i + 1
    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
```

## FINDINGS: Complete Lifecycle Analysis

### ✅ **Does the lifecycle work?**

**YES**, the complete lifecycle is sound:
1. **Injection**: Triggered after all reviews are complete (no unscored dimensions) AND objective backlog exists
2. **Display**: Rendered as a "Workflow step" in `next` and `plan queue`
3. **Auto-resolution**: Running `desloppify plan` automatically removes it
4. **Manual resolution**: User can run `desloppify plan done "workflow::create-plan" --note "..."` to resolve manually

---

### ⚠️ **Potential Edge Cases & Issues**

#### **Issue 1: ID Storage vs. Matching Inconsistency**

**Location**: `stale_dimensions.py` vs `cmd.py`

- **Constant defined**: `WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID = "workflow::create-plan"` (line 30 in `stale_dimensions.py`)
- **Imported in `cmd.py`** via: `from desloppify.engine.plan import WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID, ...`
- **BUT**: In `cmd.py:35`, it checks `if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in plan.get("queue_order", [])`

**Risk**: If the constant is ever changed in one place but not another, the string won't match. However, this is **mitigated** by using a single constant definition and explicit imports.

✅ **Status**: Low risk — the constant is centrally defined and properly imported.

---

#### **Issue 2: Injection Requires ALL Conditions to Be Met**

**Critical condition chain** (`stale_dimensions.py:364-409`):

1. ✅ Item not already in queue
2. ✅ No synthesis stages pending (`any(sid in order for sid in SYNTHESIS_IDS)`)
3. ✅ **No unscored dimensions remain** — **This is the gating condition**
4. ✅ At least one objective finding exists

**The risk**: If subjective dimensions are removed from the queue but still marked as `placeholder=True` in the state, the injection will fail because `_current_unscored_ids()` will still return them.

**Example scenario**:
```python
# If subjective dimension is in queue_order but marked as placeholder
plan.queue_order = ["subjective::design", "objective::finding1"]
state.dimension_scores["design"].detectors.subjective_assessment.placeholder = True

# Then sync_create_plan_needed will see unscored = {"subjective::design"}
# and refuse to inject workflow::create-plan
```

⚠️ **Status**: Moderate risk — requires coordinated state management.

---

#### **Issue 3: Item Can Get Stuck if No Objective Backlog**

**Scenario**: User completes all subjective reviews but there are NO objective findings.

```python
# sync_create_plan_needed will NOT inject because:
has_objective = any(
    f.get("status") == "open"
    and f.get("detector") not in ("review", "concerns", ...)
    for f in findings.values()
)
if not has_objective:
    return result  # <-- NO INJECTION
```

✅ **This is correct behavior** — if there are no objective items to plan, there's nothing to create a plan about.

---

#### **Issue 4: Resolution Mechanism Uses String Matching**

**Location**: `override_handlers.py:379-391`

```python
def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
    return fid.startswith("synthesis::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")

def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns, plan):
    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
    return synthetic, remaining
```

**Risk**: Any ID starting with `workflow::` will be treated as synthetic, even if it's a typo like `workflow::create-pla` (missing 'n'). However, such typos will be purged silently.

✅ **Status**: Low risk — the check is broad enough that malformed IDs won't match real findings.

---

#### **Issue 5: Two Different Removal Methods**

**Method 1 - Auto-remove on `plan` execution** (`cmd.py:35-36`):
```python
if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in plan.get("queue_order", []):
    purge_ids(plan, [WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID])
```

**Method 2 - Manual `plan done` flow** (`override_handlers.py:413-414`):
```python
if synthetic_ids:
    purge_ids(plan, synthetic_ids)
```

**Both use the same `purge_ids()` function**, which does:
```python
# From the import: from desloppify.engine.plan import purge_ids
# (presumably removes from queue_order, overrides, clusters)
```

✅ **Status**: Consistent — both paths use the same removal function.

---

#### **Issue 6: Synthesis Stages Block Injection**

**Gate in `stale_dimensions.py:383-385`:**
```python
if any(sid in order for sid in SYNTHESIS_IDS):
    return result  # DON'T INJECT
```

**Reason**: User should complete synthesis (planning) workflow before the `create-plan` step is offered.

**Scenario where this works correctly**:
1. Reviews produce findings → `synthesis::*` stages injected
2. User runs `desloppify plan synthesize` → stages completed, removed from queue
3. Next scan/import → `workflow::create-plan` can now be injected

✅ **Status**: Correct — prevents workflow ordering confusion.

---

```
   503→def render_followup_nudges(
   504→    state: dict,

   507→    *,
   508→    strict_score: float | None,

   515→        format_queue_block,
   516→    )
   517→
   518→    subjective_threshold = target_strict_score
   519→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective(state, dim_scores)
   520→    followup = build_subjective_followup(

   527→    unassessed_subjective = unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores)
   528→    # Show frozen plan-start score + queue block when in an active cycle
   529→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   530→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   531→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   532→        print()
   533→        for text, style in block:
   534→            print(colorize(text, style))
   535→        print(colorize(
   536→            "  Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   537→            "dim",
   538→        ))
   539→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   540→        print(
   541→            colorize(

   543→                "cyan",
   544→            )
   545→        )
   546→        print(
   547→            colorize(
   548→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   549→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   550→                "dim",
   551→            )
   552→        )
   553→    elif strict_score is not None:
   554→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   555→        if gap > 0:
   556→            print(
   557→                colorize(

   566→                    "green",

   574→
   575→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   576→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   577→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   578→    _objective_remaining = max(

   582→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   583→        try:

   585→            subjective_drag = sum(

   594→            )
   595→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   596→                print(colorize(

   601→                print(colorize(

   607→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:

   609→
   610→    # Integrity penalty/warn lines preserved (anti-gaming safeguard, must remain visible).
   611→    for style, message in followup.integrity_lines:

   613→
   614→    # Rescan nudge after structural work

   618→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",

   620→        ))
   621→
   622→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   623→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(

   626→    parts: list[str] = []

   634→    if low_dims:

   647→        print(colorize("  Run `desloppify show subjective` for details.", "dim"))
```

```
    12→def serialize_item(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    13→    """Build a serializable output dict from a queue item."""
    14→    # Cluster meta-items get their own serialization
    15→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    16→        members_raw = item.get("members", [])
    17→        serialized_members = [serialize_item(m) for m in members_raw]
    18→        serialized_cluster: dict[str, Any] = {
    19→            "id": item.get("id"),
    20→            "kind": "cluster",
    21→            "action_type": item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"),
    22→            "summary": item.get("summary"),
    23→            "member_count": item.get("member_count", len(serialized_members)),
    24→            "members": serialized_members,
    25→            "cluster_name": item.get("cluster_name", item.get("id")),
    26→            "cluster_auto": item.get("cluster_auto", True),
    27→            "detector": item.get("detector"),
    28→        }
    29→        serialized_cluster["primary_command"] = item.get("primary_command")
    30→        return serialized_cluster
    31→
    32→    serialized: dict[str, Any] = {
    33→        "id": item.get("id"),
    34→        "kind": item.get("kind", "finding"),
    35→        "confidence": item.get("confidence"),
    36→        "detector": item.get("detector"),
    37→        "file": item.get("file"),
    38→        "summary": item.get("summary"),
    39→        "detail": item.get("detail", {}),
    40→        "status": item.get("status"),
    41→    }
    42→    serialized["primary_command"] = item.get("primary_command")
    43→    explain = item.get("explain")
    44→    if explain is not None:
    45→        serialized["explain"] = explain
    46→
    47→    # Plan metadata
    48→    if item.get("queue_position"):
    49→        serialized["queue_position"] = item["queue_position"]
    50→    if item.get("plan_description"):
    51→        serialized["plan_description"] = item["plan_description"]
    52→    if item.get("plan_note"):
    53→        serialized["plan_note"] = item["plan_note"]
    54→    if item.get("plan_cluster"):
    55→        serialized["plan_cluster"] = item["plan_cluster"]
    56→    if item.get("plan_skipped"):
    57→        serialized["plan_skipped"] = True
    58→        serialized["plan_skip_kind"] = item.get("plan_skip_kind", "temporary")
    59→        if item.get("plan_skip_reason"):
    60→            serialized["plan_skip_reason"] = item["plan_skip_reason"]
    61→
    62→    return serialized
    63→
    64→
    65→def build_query_payload(
    66→    queue: Mapping[str, Any],
    67→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    68→    *,
    69→    command: str,
    70→    narrative: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    71→    plan: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    72→) -> dict[str, Any]:
    73→    """Build JSON payload for query.json and non-terminal output modes."""
    74→    serialized = [serialize_item(item) for item in items]
    75→    queue_section: dict[str, Any] = {
    76→        "total": queue.get("total", len(items)),
    77→        "suppressed_count": queue.get("suppressed_count", 0),
    78→    }
    79→
    80→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
    81→        "command": command,
    82→        "items": serialized,
    83→        "queue": queue_section,
    84→        "narrative": narrative,
    85→    }
    86→
    87→    if plan and (
    88→        plan.get("queue_order")
    89→        or plan.get("skipped")
    90→        or plan.get("clusters")
    91→    ):
    92→        clusters_summary = []
    93→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
    94→            member_ids = set(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
    95→            clusters_summary.append({
    96→                "name": name,
    97→                "description": cluster.get("description"),
    98→                "item_count": len(member_ids),
    99→            })
   100→        payload["plan"] = {
   101→            "active": True,
   102→            "focus": plan.get("active_cluster"),
   103→            "clusters": clusters_summary,
   104→            "total_ordered": len(plan.get("queue_order", [])),
   105→            "total_skipped": len(plan.get("skipped", {})),
   106→            "plan_overrides_narrative": True,
   107→        }
   108→
   109→    return payload
   110→
   111→
   112→def render_markdown(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   113→    """Render queue items as markdown."""
   114→    lines = [
   115→        "# Desloppify Next Queue",
   116→        "",
   117→        "| Kind | Confidence | Summary | Command |",
   118→        "|------|------------|---------|---------|",
   119→    ]
   120→    for item in items:
   121→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   122→        conf = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   123→        summary = item.get("summary", "").replace("|", "\\|")
   124→        command = (item.get("primary_command", "") or "").replace("|", "\\|")
   125→        lines.append(f"| {kind} | {conf} | {summary} | {command} |")
   126→    lines.append("")
   127→    return "\n".join(lines)
   128→
   129→
   130→def write_output_file(
   131→    output_file: str,
   132→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   133→    item_count: int,
   134→    *,
   135→    safe_write_text_fn,
   136→    colorize_fn,
   137→) -> bool:
   138→    """Persist payload to file and print success/failure hints."""
   139→    try:
   140→        safe_write_text_fn(output_file, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
   141→        print(colorize_fn(f"Wrote {item_count} items to {output_file}", "green"))
   142→    except OSError as exc:
   143→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
   144→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="next output")
   145→        return False
   146→    return True
   147→
   148→
   149→def emit_non_terminal_output(
   150→    output_format: str,
   151→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   152→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
   153→) -> bool:
   154→    """Render JSON/markdown output variants."""
   155→    renderers = {
   156→        "json": lambda: print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2)),
   157→        "md": lambda: print(render_markdown(items)),
   158→    }
   159→    renderer = renderers.get(output_format)
   160→    if renderer is None:
   161→        return False
   162→    renderer()
   163→    return True
   164→
   165→
   166→__all__ = [
   167→    "build_query_payload",
   168→    "emit_non_terminal_output",
   169→    "render_markdown",
   170→    "serialize_item",
   171→    "write_output_file",
   172→]
   173→
```

1→<!-- desloppify-begin -->
     2→<!-- desloppify-skill-version: 2 -->
     3→---
     4→name: desloppify
     5→description: >
     6→  Codebase health scanner and technical debt tracker. Use when the user asks
     7→  about code quality, technical debt, dead code, large files, god classes,
     8→  duplicate functions, code smells, naming issues, import cycles, or coupling
     9→  problems. Also use when asked for a health score, what to fix next, or to
    10→  create a cleanup plan. Supports 28 languages.
    11→allowed-tools: Bash(desloppify *)
    12→---
    13→
    14→# Desloppify
    15→
    16→## 1. Your Job
    17→
    18→Maximise the **strict score** honestly. Your main cycle: **scan → plan → execute → rescan**. Follow the scan output's **INSTRUCTIONS FOR AGENTS** — don't substitute your own analysis.
    19→
    20→**Don't be lazy.** Do large refactors and small detailed fixes with equal energy. If it takes touching 20 files, touch 20 files. If it's a one-line change, make it. No task is too big or too small — fix things properly, not minimally.
    21→
    22→## 2. The Workflow
    23→
    24→Three phases, repeated as a cycle.
    25→
    26→### Phase 1: Scan and review — understand the codebase
    27→
    28→```bash
    29→desloppify scan --path .       # analyse the codebase
    30→desloppify status              # check scores — are we at target?
    31→```
    32→
    33→The scan will tell you if subjective dimensions need review. Follow its instructions. To trigger a review manually:
    34→```bash
    35→desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import
    36→```
    37→
    38→### Phase 2: Plan — decide what to work on
    39→
    40→If synthesis is pending (it will be after a subjective review), complete it first — this is how you digest review results into a strategy:
    41→```bash
    42→desloppify plan synthesize                          # dashboard — see stage progress
    43→desloppify plan synthesize --stage observe --report "themes and root causes..."
    44→desloppify plan synthesize --stage reflect --report "comparison against completed work..."
    45→desloppify plan synthesize --stage organize --report "summary of priorities..."
    46→desloppify plan synthesize --complete --strategy "execution plan..."
    47→```
    48→
    49→Then shape the queue. **The plan shapes everything `next` gives you** — don't skip this step.
    50→
    51→```bash
    52→desloppify plan                          # see the full ordered queue
    53→desloppify plan move <pat> top           # reorder — what unblocks the most?
    54→desloppify plan cluster create <name>    # group related issues to batch-fix
    55→desloppify plan focus <cluster>          # scope next to one cluster
    56→desloppify plan skip <pat>              # defer — hide from next
    57→```
    58→
    59→More plan commands:
    60→```bash
    61→desloppify plan move <cluster> top       # move all cluster members at once
    62→desloppify plan move <a> <b> top         # mix clusters + findings in one move
    63→desloppify plan move <pat> before -t X   # position relative to another item/cluster
    64→desloppify plan cluster move a,b top     # move multiple clusters as one block
    65→desloppify plan done <pat>               # mark complete
    66→desloppify plan reopen <pat>             # reopen
    67→```
    68→
    69→### Phase 3: Execute — grind the queue to completion
    70→
    71→Trust the plan and execute. Don't rescan mid-queue — finish the queue first.
    72→
    73→```
    74→1. desloppify next              ← what to fix next
    75→2. Fix the issue in code
    76→3. Resolve it (next shows you the exact command including required attestation)
    77→4. Repeat until the queue is empty
    78→```
    79→
    80→Score may temporarily drop after fixes — cascade effects are normal, keep going.
    81→If `next` suggests an auto-fixer, run `desloppify fix <fixer> --dry-run` to preview, then apply.
    82→
    83→**When the queue is clear, go back to Phase 1.** New issues will surface, cascades will have resolved, priorities will have shifted. This is the cycle.
    84→
    85→### Other useful commands
    86→
    87→```bash
    88→desloppify next --count 5                         # top 5 priorities
    89→desloppify next --cluster <name>                  # drill into a cluster
    90→desloppify show <pattern>                         # filter by file/detector/ID
    91→desloppify show --status open                     # all open findings
    92→desloppify plan skip --permanent "<id>" --note "reason" --attest "..." # accept debt
    93→desloppify exclude <path>                         # exclude a directory from scanning
    94→desloppify config show                            # show all config including excludes
    95→desloppify scan --path . --reset-subjective       # reset subjective baseline to 0
    96→```
    97→
    98→## 3. Reference
    99→
   100→### How scoring works
   101→
   102→Overall score = **40% mechanical** + **60% subjective**.
   103→
   104→- **Mechanical (40%)**: auto-detected issues — duplication, dead code, smells, unused imports, security. Fixed by changing code and rescanning.
   105→- **Subjective (60%)**: design quality review — naming, error handling, abstractions, clarity. Starts at **0%** until reviewed. The scan will prompt you when a review is needed.
   106→- **Strict score** is the north star: wontfix items count as open. The gap between overall and strict is your wontfix debt.
   107→- **Score types**: overall (lenient), strict (wontfix counts), objective (mechanical only), verified (confirmed fixes only).
   108→
   109→### Subjective reviews in detail
   110→
   111→- **Preferred**: `desloppify review --run-batches --runner codex --parallel --scan-after-import` — does everything in one command.
   112→- **Manual path**: `desloppify review --prepare` → review per dimension → `desloppify review --import file.json`.
   113→- Import first, fix after — import creates tracked state entries for correlation.
   114→- Integrity: reviewers score from evidence only. Scores hitting exact targets trigger auto-reset.
   115→- Even moderate scores (60-80) dramatically improve overall health.
   116→- Stale dimensions auto-surface in `next` — just follow the queue.
   117→
   118→### Key concepts
   119→
   120→- **Tiers**: T1 auto-fix → T2 quick manual → T3 judgment call → T4 major refactor.
   121→- **Auto-clusters**: related findings are auto-grouped in `next`. Drill in with `next --cluster <name>`.
   122→- **Zones**: production/script (scored), test/config/generated/vendor (not scored). Fix with `zone set`.
   123→- **Wontfix cost**: widens the lenient↔strict gap. Challenge past decisions when the gap grows.
   124→- Score can temporarily drop after fixes (cascade effects are normal).
   125→
   126→## 4. Escalate Tool Issues Upstream
   127→
   128→When desloppify itself appears wrong or inconsistent:
   129→
   130→1. Capture a minimal repro (`command`, `path`, `expected`, `actual`).
   131→2. Open a GitHub issue in `peteromallet/desloppify`.
   132→3. If you can fix it safely, open a PR linked to that issue.
   133→4. If unsure whether it is tool bug vs user workflow, issue first, PR second.
   134→
   135→## Prerequisite
   136→
   137→`command -v desloppify >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "desloppify: installed" || echo "NOT INSTALLED — run: pip install --upgrade git+https://github.com/peteromallet/desloppify.git"`
   138→
   139→<!-- desloppify-end -->
   140→

```
    46→def _print_single_finding(finding: dict, *, show_code: bool) -> None:
    47→    """Render a single finding to terminal."""
    48→    normalized_status = canonical_finding_status(finding.get("status"))
    49→    status_icon = {
    50→        "open": "○",
    51→        "fixed": "✓",
    52→        "wontfix": "—",
    53→        "false_positive": "✗",
    54→        "auto_resolved": "◌",
    55→    }.get(normalized_status, "?")
    56→    zone = finding.get("zone", "production")
    57→    zone_tag = colorize(f" [{zone}]", "dim") if zone != "production" else ""
    58→    print(
    59→        f"    {status_icon} T{finding['tier']} [{finding['confidence']}] {finding['summary']}{zone_tag}"
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    detail_parts = format_detail(finding.get("detail", {}))
    63→    if detail_parts:
    64→        print(colorize(f"      {' · '.join(detail_parts)}", "dim"))
    65→    if show_code:
    66→        detail = finding.get("detail", {})
    67→        target_line = (
    68→            detail.get("line") or (detail.get("lines", [None]) or [None])[0]
    69→        )
    70→        if target_line and finding["file"] not in (".", ""):
    71→            snippet = read_code_snippet(finding["file"], target_line)
    72→            if snippet:
    73→                print(snippet)
    74→    if finding.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2:
    75→        print(
    76→            colorize(
    77→                f"      ⟳ reopened {finding['reopen_count']} times — fix properly or wontfix",
    78→                "red",
    79→            )
    80→        )
    81→    if finding.get("note"):
    82→        print(colorize(f"      note: {finding['note']}", "dim"))
    83→    print(colorize(f"      {finding['id']}", "dim"))
    84→
    85→
    86→def render_findings(
    87→    matches: list[dict],
    88→    *,
    89→    pattern: str,
    90→    status_filter: str,
    91→    show_code: bool,
    92→    top: int,
    93→    hidden_by_detector: dict[str, int],
    94→    hidden_total: int,
    95→    noise_budget: int,
    96→    global_noise_budget: int,
    97→    budget_warning: str | None,
    98→) -> None:
    99→    """Render grouped findings and rollup summary to terminal."""
   100→    sorted_files = group_matches_by_file(matches)
   101→    print(
   102→        colorize(
   103→            f"\n  {len(matches)} {status_filter} findings matching '{pattern}'\n",
   104→            "bold",
   105→        )
   106→    )
   107→    if budget_warning:
   108→        print(colorize(f"  {budget_warning}\n", "yellow"))
   109→    if hidden_total:
   110→        global_label = (
   111→            f", {global_noise_budget} global" if global_noise_budget > 0 else ""
   112→        )
   113→        hidden_parts = ", ".join(
   114→            f"{det}: +{count}" for det, count in hidden_by_detector.items()
   115→        )
   116→        print(
   117→            colorize(
   118→                (
   119→                    "  Noise budget: "
   120→                    f"{noise_budget}/detector{global_label} "
   121→                    f"({hidden_total} hidden: {hidden_parts})\n"
   122→                ),
   123→                "dim",
   124→            )
   125→        )
   126→
   127→    shown_files = sorted_files[:top]
   128→    remaining_files = sorted_files[top:]
   129→    remaining_findings = sum(len(files) for _, files in remaining_files)
   130→
   131→    for filepath, findings in shown_files:
   132→        findings.sort(
   133→            key=lambda finding: (
   134→                finding["tier"],
   135→                CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(finding["confidence"], 9),
   136→            )
   137→        )
   138→        display_path = "Codebase-wide" if filepath == "." else filepath
   139→        print(
   140→            colorize(f"  {display_path}", "cyan")
   141→            + colorize(f"  ({len(findings)} findings)", "dim")
   142→        )
   143→
   144→        for finding in findings:
   145→            _print_single_finding(finding, show_code=show_code)
   146→        print()
   147→
   148→    if remaining_findings:
   149→        print(
   150→            colorize(
   151→                (
   152→                    f"  ... and {len(remaining_files)} more files "
   153→                    f"({remaining_findings} findings). "
   154→                    f"Use --top {top + 20} to see more.\n"
   155→                ),
   156→                "dim",
   157→            )
   158→        )
   159→
   160→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
   161→    by_tier: dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)
   162→    for finding in matches:
   163→        by_detector[finding["detector"]] += 1
   164→        by_tier[finding["tier"]] += 1
   165→
   166→    print(colorize("  Summary:", "bold"))
   167→    print(
   168→        colorize(
   169→            (
   170→                "    By tier:     "
   171→                + ", ".join(
   172→                    f"T{tier}:{count}" for tier, count in sorted(by_tier.items())
   173→                )
   174→            ),
   175→            "dim",
   176→        )
   177→    )
   178→    print(
   179→        colorize(
   180→            (
   181→                "    By detector: "
   182→                + ", ".join(
   183→                    f"{detector}:{count}"
   184→                    for detector, count in sorted(
   185→                        by_detector.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1]
   186→                    )
   187→                )
   188→            ),
   189→            "dim",
   190→        )
   191→    )
   192→    if hidden_total:
   193→        print(
   194→            colorize(
   195→                (

   197→                    + ", ".join(

   199→                        for detector, count in hidden_by_detector.items()
   200→                    )
   201→                ),
   202→                "dim",
   203→            )
   204→        )
   205→    print()

   208→def show_agent_plan(
   209→    narrative: dict, matches: list[dict], *, plan: dict | None = None
   210→) -> None:
   211→    """Render a compact plan from current findings and narrative actions.
   212→
   213→    When a living *plan* is active, renders plan focus/progress instead.
   214→    """
   215→    if plan and (plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("clusters")):

   223→    actions = narrative.get("actions", [])

   227→    print(

   255→def show_subjective_followup(

   263→    subjective = reporting_dimensions_mod.scorecard_subjective_entries(
```
